senses.definition: events that are of public interest or political importance

examples.x: world/international affairs
an expert on foreign affairs (= political events in other countries)
We are expecting a statement from the home affairs (= political events in your own country) spokesman.
internal/external affairs
affairs of state

senses.definition_vi: các sự kiện có sự quan tâm của công chúng hoặc tầm quan trọng chính trị

senses.definition: an event that people are talking about or describing in a particular way

examples.x: The newspapers exaggerated the whole affair wildly.
She wanted the celebration to be a simple family affair.
Many people have criticized the way the government handled the affair.
The Whitewater affair was the biggest scandal of the decade.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện mà mọi người đang nói đến hoặc mô tả theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: a sexual relationship between two people, usually when one or both of them are already in a relationship with somebody else

examples.x: She was having an affair with a co-worker.
an extramarital affair
It's the story of a secret affair between a married teacher and her teenage student.

senses.definition_vi: một mối quan hệ tình dục giữa hai người, thường là khi một hoặc cả hai người đã có mối quan hệ với người khác

senses.definition: matters connected with a person’s private business and financial situation

examples.x: She manages the family's financial affairs.
I looked after my father's financial affairs.
She wanted to put her affairs in order before she died.

senses.definition_vi: các vấn đề liên quan đến tình hình kinh doanh và tài chính riêng tư của một người

senses.definition: a thing that somebody is responsible for (and that other people should not be interested in)

examples.x: How I spend my money is my affair.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ mà ai đó chịu trách nhiệm (và mà người khác không nên quan tâm)

senses.definition: an object that is unusual or difficult to describe

examples.x: Her hat was an amazing affair with feathers and a huge brim.

senses.definition_vi: một vật dụng khác thường hoặc khó mô tả

senses.definition: a situation

examples.x: This state of affairs can no longer be ignored.

senses.definition_vi: một tình huống

senses.definition: to produce a change in somebody/something

examples.x: How will these changes affect us?
The article deals with issues affecting the lives of children.
Thousands of people have been adversely affected (= affected in a negative way) by the decision.
The quality and health of the soil directly affects the quality and health of the plants.
Your opinion will not affect my decision.
The south of the country was worst affected by the drought.

senses.definition_vi: tạo ra sự thay đổi ở ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to attack somebody or a part of the body; to make somebody become ill

examples.x: The disease is more likely to affect women than men.
The condition affects one in five women.
Rub the cream into the affected areas.

senses.definition_vi: tấn công ai đó hoặc một bộ phận cơ thể; làm cho ai đó bị bệnh

senses.definition: to make somebody feel very sad, sorry, etc. about somebody/something

examples.x: They were deeply affected by the news of her death.
Her death affected him deeply.
Try not to let his problems affect you too much.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó cảm thấy rất buồn, tiếc, v.v. về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to pretend to be feeling or thinking something

examples.x: She affected a calmness she did not feel.
We are fascinated by the rich and powerful but often affect to despise them.

senses.definition_vi: giả vờ cảm thấy hoặc suy nghĩ về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to use or wear something that is intended to impress other people

examples.x: I wish he wouldn't affect that ridiculous accent.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng hoặc mặc thứ gì đó có ý định gây ấn tượng với người khác

senses.definition: the feeling of liking or loving somebody/something very much and caring about them

examples.x: Children need lots of love and affection.
He didn't show his wife any affection.
She was held in deep affection by all her students.
Mr Darcy’s affection for his sister
I have a great affection for New York.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác rất thích hoặc yêu ai đó/điều gì đó và quan tâm đến họ

senses.definition: a person’s feelings of love

examples.x: Anne had two men trying to win her affections.
The object of her affections was a young man named Paul.

senses.definition_vi: tình cảm yêu thương của một người

senses.definition: to have enough money to be able to buy or do something

examples.x: Can we afford a new car?
None of them could afford £50 for a ticket.
I’d give up work if I could afford it.
We can't afford to go abroad this summer.
She never took a taxi, even though she could afford to.
She can well afford to pay for herself.
They couldn't afford to buy a house there.
We can't afford to have children.
He couldn't afford the money to go on the trip.

senses.definition_vi: có đủ tiền để mua hoặc làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: if you say that you can’t afford to do something, you mean that you should not do it because it will cause problems for you if you do

examples.x: We cannot afford to ignore this warning.
They could ill afford to lose any more staff.
The people who suffer most are those who can least afford to lose.
We simply can't afford to take any risks.
She felt she couldn't afford any more time off work.
We cannot afford any more delays.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói rằng bạn không đủ khả năng làm điều gì đó, bạn có nghĩa là bạn không nên làm điều đó vì nó sẽ gây rắc rối cho bạn nếu bạn làm

senses.definition: to provide somebody with something

examples.x: The tree affords some shelter from the sun.
The legislation aims to afford protection to employees.
Being a college professor affords you the opportunity simply to write and do research.
The programme affords young people the chance to gain work experience.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho ai đó thứ gì đó

senses.definition: cheap enough that people can afford to pay it or buy it

examples.x: We offer quality products at affordable prices.
There is a lack of affordable housing in the city.
This model is relatively affordable at just $85.

senses.definition_vi: đủ rẻ để mọi người có thể chi trả hoặc mua được

senses.definition: feeling fear; frightened because you think that you might be hurt or suffer

examples.x: Don't be afraid.
It's all over. There's nothing to be afraid of now.
He had always been afraid of dogs.
They know I'm afraid of heights.
Are you afraid of spiders?
I started to feel afraid of going out alone at night.
The children were afraid to open the door.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy sợ hãi; hoảng sợ vì bạn nghĩ rằng mình có thể bị tổn thương hoặc đau khổ

senses.definition: worried about what might happen

examples.x: She was afraid of upsetting her parents.
He was afraid of making a fool of himself.
Don't be afraid to ask if you don't understand.
She certainly isn't afraid to speak her mind.
We were afraid (that) we were going to capsize the boat.

senses.definition_vi: lo lắng về những gì có thể xảy ra

senses.definition: worried or frightened that something unpleasant, dangerous, etc. will happen to a particular person or thing

examples.x: I'm not afraid for me, but for the baby.
They had already fired three people and he was afraid for his job.
I am very afraid for their safety.
I was afraid for my life.

senses.definition_vi: lo lắng hoặc sợ hãi rằng điều gì đó khó chịu, nguy hiểm, v.v. sẽ xảy ra với một người hoặc vật cụ thể

senses.definition: used as a polite way of telling somebody something that is unpleasant or disappointing, or that you are sorry about

examples.x: I can't help you, I'm afraid.
I'm afraid we can't come.
I'm afraid that it's not finished yet.
He's no better, I'm afraid to say.
‘Is there any left?’ ‘I'm afraid not.’
‘Will it hurt?’ ‘I'm afraid so.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng như một cách lịch sự để nói với ai đó điều gì đó khó chịu hoặc đáng thất vọng, hoặc bạn lấy làm tiếc

senses.definition: later in time; afterwards

examples.x: That was in 1996. Soon after, I heard that he'd died.
I could come next week, or the week after.
And they all lived happily ever after.

senses.definition_vi: muộn hơn về thời gian; sau đó

senses.definition: at a time later than something; when something has finished

examples.x: I'll call you after I've spoken to them.
Several years after they'd split up they met again by chance in Paris.

senses.definition_vi: muộn hơn một điều gì đó; sau khi một điều gì đó kết thúc

senses.definition: later than something; following something in time

examples.x: We'll leave after lunch.
They arrived shortly after 5.
Not long after that he resigned.
Let’s meet the day after tomorrow/the week after next.
After winning the prize she became famous overnight.
After an hour I went home (= when an hour had passed).
It’s ten after seven in the morning (= 7.10 a.m.).

senses.definition_vi: muộn hơn một điều gì đó; theo sau một điều gì đó về thời gian

senses.definition: next to and following somebody/something in order or importance

examples.x: Your name comes after mine in the list.
He's the tallest, after Richard.
After you (= Please go first).
After you with the charger (= Can I have it next?).

senses.definition_vi: bên cạnh và theo sau ai đó/điều gì đó về thứ tự hoặc tầm quan trọng

senses.definition: behind somebody when they have left; following somebody

examples.x: Shut the door after you.
I'm always having to clean up after the children (= clean the place after they have left it dirty and untidy).
He ran after her with the book.
She was left staring after him.

senses.definition_vi: phía sau ai đó khi họ đã rời đi; theo sau ai đó

senses.definition: in contrast to something

examples.x: It was pleasantly cool in the house after the sticky heat outside.

senses.definition_vi: trái ngược với một điều gì đó

senses.definition: as a result of or because of something that has happened

examples.x: I'll never forgive them after what they did.

senses.definition_vi: là kết quả của hoặc vì điều gì đó đã xảy ra

senses.definition: despite something; although something has happened

examples.x: I can't believe she'd do that, not after all I've done for her.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp một điều gì đó; mặc dù một điều gì đó đã xảy ra

senses.definition: used to show that something happens many times or continuously

examples.x: day after day of hot weather
I've told you time after time not to do that.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện nhiều lần hoặc liên tục

senses.definition: trying to find or catch somebody/something

examples.x: The police are after them.
He's after a job at our place.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng tìm hoặc bắt ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: about somebody/something

examples.x: She asked after you (= how you were).

senses.definition_vi: về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: in the style of somebody/something; following the example of somebody/something

examples.x: a painting after Goya
We named the baby Ena after her grandmother.

senses.definition_vi: theo phong cách của ai đó/điều gì đó; theo gương ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: happening or done later than the time or event mentioned

examples.x: after-hours drinking (= after closing time)
an after-school club
after-dinner mints

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện muộn hơn thời gian hoặc sự kiện được đề cập

senses.definition: despite what has been said or expected

examples.x: So you made it after all!

senses.definition_vi: mặc dù những gì đã được nói hoặc mong đợi

senses.definition: used when you are explaining something, or giving a reason

examples.x: He should have paid. He suggested it, after all.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang giải thích điều gì đó, hoặc đưa ra một lý do

senses.definition: to be going to do something soon; to be intending to do something soon
senses.definition_vi: sắp sửa làm điều gì đó sớm; có ý định làm điều gì đó sớm

senses.definition: to have just done something
senses.definition_vi: vừa mới làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: the situation that exists as a result of an important (and usually unpleasant) event, especially a war, an accident, etc.

examples.x: A lot of rebuilding took place in the aftermath of the war.
the assassination of the prime minister and its immediate aftermath
How does a country cope with the aftermath of war?
The president visited the region in the immediate aftermath of the disaster.

senses.definition_vi: tình huống tồn tại như là kết quả của một sự kiện quan trọng (và thường không dễ chịu), đặc biệt là chiến tranh, tai nạn, v.v.

senses.definition: the period of time from 12 o'clock in the middle of the day until about 6 o’clock in the evening

examples.x: this/yesterday/tomorrow afternoon
In the afternoon, they went shopping.
Where were you on the afternoon of May 21?
Heavy snow arrived during the afternoon.
She studies art two afternoons a week.
Come over on Sunday afternoon.
The baby always has an afternoon nap.
Are you ready for this afternoon's meeting?
The activities are split into morning and afternoon sessions.

senses.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian từ 12 giờ trưa đến khoảng 6 giờ tối

senses.definition: at a later time; after an event that has already been mentioned

examples.x: Afterwards she was sorry for what she'd said.
Let's go out now and eat afterwards.
Shortly afterwards he met her again.
He went to dinner at a restaurant, and soon afterwards, he fell ill.

senses.definition_vi: vào một thời điểm sau đó; sau một sự kiện đã được đề cập

senses.definition: one more time; on another occasion

examples.x: This must never happen again.
Try again—it takes practice.
Can we start again, please?
Could you say it again, please?
When will I see you again?
This author again proves to be a superb storyteller.
I've told you again and again (= many times) not to do that.
I'll have to write it all over again (= again from the beginning).
She tried over and over again (= many times) to get it right.
He has yet again (= as has happened many times before) shown that he cannot be trusted.
Once again (= as had happened several times before), the train was late.

senses.definition_vi: một lần nữa; vào một dịp khác

senses.definition: showing that somebody/something is in the same place or state that they were in originally

examples.x: We're very happy to be here together again.
He was glad to be home again.
You'll soon feel well again.
She spends two hours a day getting to work and back again.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy ai đó/điều gì đó ở cùng một nơi hoặc trạng thái như ban đầu

senses.definition: added to an amount that is already there

examples.x: The cost is about half as much again as it was two years ago.
I'd like the same again (= the same amount or the same thing).

senses.definition_vi: được thêm vào một số lượng đã có sẵn

senses.definition: used to show that a comment or fact is connected with what you have just said

examples.x: And again, we must think of the cost.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy một nhận xét hoặc sự thật có liên quan đến những gì bạn vừa nói

senses.definition: used to introduce a fact or an opinion that contrasts with what you have just said

examples.x: We might buy it but then again we might not.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để giới thiệu một sự thật hoặc một ý kiến trái ngược với những gì bạn vừa nói

senses.definition: used when you ask somebody to tell you something or repeat something that you think they have told you already

examples.x: What was the name again?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn yêu cầu ai đó nói lại điều gì đó hoặc lặp lại điều gì đó mà bạn nghĩ họ đã nói trước đó

senses.definition: from time to time; occasionally

examples.x: Every now and again she checked to see if he was still asleep.

senses.definition_vi: thỉnh thoảng; đôi khi

senses.definition: used to ask somebody to serve you the same drink as before

examples.x: Same again, please!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để yêu cầu ai đó phục vụ bạn cùng một loại đồ uống như trước

senses.definition: often; on many or all occasions

examples.x: You will get a perfect result time after time if you follow these instructions.
Time and again, the girls have shown how strong and determined they can be.

senses.definition_vi: thường xuyên; vào nhiều hoặc tất cả các dịp

senses.definition: opposing or disagreeing with somebody/something

examples.x: the fight against terrorism
We're playing against the league champions next week.
We were rowing against the current.
That's against the law.
Employees can't be forced to join a union against their will.
Are you for or against the death penalty?
She is against seeing (= does not want to see) him.
I'd advise you against doing that.

senses.definition_vi: phản đối hoặc không đồng ý với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: not to the advantage or favour of somebody/something

examples.x: The evidence is against him.
Her age is against her.

senses.definition_vi: không có lợi hoặc không ủng hộ ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: close to, touching or hitting somebody/something

examples.x: Put the piano there, against the wall.
The rain beat against the windows.

senses.definition_vi: gần, chạm hoặc va vào ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: in order to prevent something from happening or to reduce the damage caused by something

examples.x: an injection against rabies
They took precautions against fire.
Are we insured against theft?
He gritted his teeth against the pain.

senses.definition_vi: để ngăn chặn điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc để giảm thiểu thiệt hại do điều gì đó gây ra

senses.definition: with something in the background, as a contrast

examples.x: His red clothes stood out clearly against the snow.
The love story unfolds against a background of civil war.

senses.definition_vi: với điều gì đó ở phía sau, như một sự tương phản

senses.definition: used when you are comparing two things

examples.x: You must weigh the benefits against the cost.
Check your receipts against the statement.
What's the rate of exchange against the dollar?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang so sánh hai điều

senses.definition: if you include money or costs against an amount that is owed, you use it to reduce the amount

examples.x: The accountant said I could offset all my travel costs against tax.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn bao gồm tiền hoặc chi phí chống lại một số tiền nợ, bạn sử dụng nó để giảm số tiền đó

senses.definition: if you borrow money against property that you own, you use the value of the property as a guarantee that you will repay the money

examples.x: They had borrowed a lot of money against the value of the house.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn vay tiền thế chấp tài sản mà bạn sở hữu, bạn sử dụng giá trị của tài sản đó làm sự đảm bảo rằng bạn sẽ trả lại tiền

senses.definition: in contrast with something

examples.x: They got 27 per cent of the vote as against 32 per cent at the last election.

senses.definition_vi: trái ngược với điều gì đó

senses.definition: you are unlikely to succeed because the conditions are not good for you
senses.definition_vi: bạn khó có thể thành công vì các điều kiện không thuận lợi cho bạn

senses.definition: the number of years that a person has lived or a thing has existed

examples.x: You're the same age as my brother.
ways of calculating the age of the earth
to reach retirement age
He left school at the age of 18.
He started playing the piano at an early age.
At your age I had already started work.
Children can start school from the age of four.
children between the ages of 5 and 10
The children range in age from 5 to 10.
The children's ages range from 5 to 10.
Children over the age of 12 must pay full fare.
The film is unsuitable for children below 12 years of age.
Young people of all ages go there to meet.
She needs more friends of her own age.
All ages admitted.
He was tall for his age (= taller than you would expect, considering his age).
She was beginning to feel her age (= feel that she was getting old).
The show appeals to all age ranges.
There’s a big age gap between them (= a big difference in their ages).

senses.definition_vi: số năm mà một người đã sống hoặc một vật đã tồn tại

senses.definition: a very long time

examples.x: It'll probably take ages to find a parking space.
I waited for ages.
Carlos left ages ago.
It's been an age since we've seen them.

senses.definition_vi: một thời gian rất dài

senses.definition: a particular period of a person’s life

examples.x: in middle/old age
15 is an awkward age.

senses.definition_vi: một giai đoạn cụ thể trong cuộc đời của một người

senses.definition: a particular period of history

examples.x: the nuclear age
We live in an age of globalization.
a study of fashion through the ages

senses.definition_vi: một giai đoạn cụ thể của lịch sử

senses.definition: the state of being old

examples.x: The jacket was showing signs of age.
White hair is a sign of great age.
Wine improves with age.
the wisdom that comes with age

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng già

senses.definition: a length of time that is a division of an epoch
senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian là một phần của một kỷ nguyên

senses.definition: to behave in a way that is suitable for somebody of your age and not as though you were much younger

examples.x: Isn’t it time you started acting your age?

senses.definition_vi: cư xử theo cách phù hợp với lứa tuổi của bạn và không như thể bạn còn trẻ hơn nhiều

senses.definition: when a person comes of age, they reach the age when they have an adult’s legal rights and responsibilities

examples.x: The money will go to the children when they come of age.

senses.definition_vi: khi một người đến tuổi thành niên, họ đạt đến độ tuổi mà họ có các quyền và trách nhiệm pháp lý của người trưởng thành

senses.definition: if something comes of age, it reaches the stage of development at which people accept and value it

examples.x: It was the year that concern for the environment really came of age.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một cái gì đó đến tuổi thành niên, nó đạt đến giai đoạn phát triển mà mọi người chấp nhận và coi trọng nó

senses.definition: to realize that you are getting old, especially compared with people you are with who are younger than you
senses.definition_vi: nhận ra rằng bạn đang già đi, đặc biệt là so với những người xung quanh bạn còn trẻ hơn

senses.definition: a great age

examples.x: She finally learned to drive at the grand old age of 70.

senses.definition_vi: một tuổi rất cao

senses.definition: now, in the modern world

examples.x: Slavery continues to exist, even in this day and age.
Why dress so formally in this day and age?

senses.definition_vi: bây giờ, trong thế giới hiện đại

senses.definition: to seem as old as you really are and not younger or older

examples.x: She doesn’t look her age; I thought she was ten years younger.

senses.definition_vi: trông già như tuổi thật của bạn và không trẻ hơn hay già hơn

senses.definition: used in polite expressions to describe somebody as ‘very old’

examples.x: He was a man of advanced years.
Even at my advanced age I still know how to enjoy myself!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong các cách diễn đạt lịch sự để mô tả ai đó là 'rất già'

senses.definition: if you talk about a person being of a certain age, you mean that they are no longer young but not yet old

examples.x: The show appeals to an audience of a certain age.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói về một người ở một độ tuổi nhất định, bạn có nghĩa là họ không còn trẻ nhưng chưa già.

senses.definition: an age that is considered to be very old

examples.x: He lived to the ripe old age of 91.

senses.definition_vi: một độ tuổi được coi là rất già.

senses.definition: not legally old enough to do a particular thing

examples.x: It is illegal to sell vapes to children who are under age.

senses.definition_vi: không đủ tuổi hợp pháp để làm một việc cụ thể.

senses.definition: to become older

examples.x: As he aged, his memory got worse.
The population is aging (= more people are living longer).
This film hasn't aged well at all (= it seems old-fashioned now).

senses.definition_vi: trở nên già hơn.

senses.definition: to look, feel or seem older; to make somebody/something look, feel or seem older

examples.x: My mother has really aged since she became ill.
The shock has aged her.
Exposure to the sun ages the skin.
These photos have been artificially aged.

senses.definition_vi: trông, cảm thấy hoặc có vẻ già hơn; làm cho ai đó/cái gì đó trông, cảm thấy hoặc có vẻ già hơn.

senses.definition: to develop in taste over a period of time; to allow something to do this

examples.x: The cheese is left to age for at least a year.
The wine is aged in oak casks.
This wine has not aged well.

senses.definition_vi: phát triển về hương vị trong một khoảng thời gian; cho phép điều này xảy ra.

senses.definition: of the age of

examples.x: They have two children aged six and nine.
volunteers aged between 25 and 40
Children have the opportunity to meet similarly aged children.

senses.definition_vi: ở độ tuổi của.

senses.definition: very old

examples.x: my aged aunt
People caring for an aged relative need support.
I’m not sure if my aged car can make it up that hill.

senses.definition_vi: rất già.

senses.definition: very old people

examples.x: services for the sick and the aged

senses.definition_vi: những người rất già.

senses.definition: a business or an organization that provides a particular service especially when representing other businesses or organizations

examples.x: She works for an advertising agency.
He managed to find a job through an agency.

senses.definition_vi: một doanh nghiệp hoặc một tổ chức cung cấp một dịch vụ cụ thể, đặc biệt là khi đại diện cho các doanh nghiệp hoặc tổ chức khác.

senses.definition: a government department that provides a particular service

examples.x: law enforcement agencies
Some laboratories are operated by government agencies.

senses.definition_vi: một cơ quan chính phủ cung cấp một dịch vụ cụ thể.

senses.definition: as a result of the action of somebody/something

examples.x: He obtained his position through the agency of an old friend.

senses.definition_vi: do hành động của ai đó/cái gì đó.

senses.definition: a list of items to be discussed at a meeting

examples.x: We have a very full agenda of issues to discuss.
The next item on the agenda is the publicity budget.

senses.definition_vi: một danh sách các mục cần thảo luận tại một cuộc họp.

senses.definition: a plan of things to be done, or problems to be addressed

examples.x: In our company, quality is high on the agenda.
They have been trying to get the issue onto the political agenda.
Child poverty has been pushed off the agenda.
Education is now at the top of the government's agenda (= most important).
Cost-cutting is top of the agenda for the next quarter.
Pressure groups have been accused of trying to set the agenda for the government (= decide what is important).
The college needs to draw up an agenda for change.

senses.definition_vi: một kế hoạch về những việc cần làm, hoặc những vấn đề cần giải quyết.

senses.definition: the intention behind what somebody says or does, that is often secret

examples.x: The artist is letting his own agenda affect what was meant to be a community project.

senses.definition_vi: ý định đằng sau những gì ai đó nói hoặc làm, thường là bí mật.

senses.definition: a person whose job is to act for, or manage the affairs of, other people in business, politics, etc.

examples.x: Our agent in New York deals with all US sales.
If you're going to rent out your house while you're abroad, you'll need someone to act as your agent here.
an insurance agent
Typical agent's fees are around 6 per cent of the sale price.

senses.definition_vi: một người có nhiệm vụ hành động thay mặt, hoặc quản lý các vấn đề của, người khác trong kinh doanh, chính trị, v.v.

senses.definition: a person whose job is to arrange work for an actor, musician, sports player, etc. or to find somebody who will publish a writer’s work

examples.x: a theatrical/literary agent

senses.definition_vi: một người có nhiệm vụ sắp xếp công việc cho một diễn viên, nhạc sĩ, vận động viên, v.v. hoặc tìm người xuất bản tác phẩm của một nhà văn.

senses.definition: a person who works secretly to obtain information for a government or other organization

examples.x: He was arrested by federal agents.
an enemy/undercover agent
CIA/FBI agents

senses.definition_vi: một người làm việc bí mật để thu thập thông tin cho chính phủ hoặc tổ chức khác.

senses.definition: a person or thing that has an important effect on a situation

examples.x: The charity has been an agent for social change.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật có ảnh hưởng quan trọng đến một tình huống.

senses.definition: a chemical or a substance that produces an effect or a change or is used for a particular purpose

examples.x: chemical/biological agents
cleaning/oxidizing agents

senses.definition_vi: một hóa chất hoặc một chất tạo ra hiệu ứng hoặc sự thay đổi hoặc được sử dụng cho một mục đích cụ thể.

senses.definition: the person or thing that does an action (expressed as the subject of an active verb, or in a ‘by’ phrase with a passive verb)
senses.definition_vi: người hoặc vật thực hiện một hành động (được biểu thị là chủ ngữ của động từ chủ động, hoặc trong cụm 'by' với động từ bị động).

senses.definition: feelings of anger and hate that may result in threatening or violent behaviour

examples.x: Video games have been blamed for causing aggression.
Nowadays our aggression is channelled into sports.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác tức giận và căm ghét có thể dẫn đến hành vi đe dọa hoặc bạo lực.

senses.definition: a violent attack or threats by one person against another person or by one country against another country

examples.x: unprovoked military aggression

senses.definition_vi: một cuộc tấn công bạo lực hoặc các mối đe dọa của một người đối với người khác hoặc của một quốc gia đối với quốc gia khác.

senses.definition: angry, and behaving in a threatening way; ready to attack

examples.x: Seals have been known to exhibit aggressive behaviour towards swimmers.
They became increasingly aggressive as the evening wore on.
There's no need to get aggressive.
She warned that her dog was aggressive towards strangers.

senses.definition_vi: tức giận và có hành vi đe dọa; sẵn sàng tấn công.

senses.definition: determined and acting with force in order to succeed

examples.x: a very aggressive advertising campaign
We need to get more aggressive in our approach.
The firm is extremely aggressive in seeking new markets.

senses.definition_vi: quyết tâm và hành động mạnh mẽ để thành công.

senses.definition: developing quickly and difficult to treat

examples.x: Doctors diagnosed her with a rare and aggressive cancer, which was feared to be incurable.

senses.definition_vi: phát triển nhanh chóng và khó điều trị.

senses.definition: using all possible treatment options in order to extend somebody’s life

examples.x: Nicholas was diagnosed with the rare disease in November and has undergone aggressive treatments since then.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng tất cả các lựa chọn điều trị có thể để kéo dài sự sống của ai đó.

senses.definition: used in expressions of time with the simple past tense to show how far in the past something happened

examples.x: two weeks/months/years ago
The letter came a few days ago.
She was here just a minute ago.
a short/long time ago
How long ago did you buy it?
It was on TV not (so) long ago.
Scientists think there was water on Mars a long time ago.
He stopped working some time ago (= quite a long time ago).
They're getting married? It's not that long ago (= it's only a short time ago) that they met!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong các diễn đạt thời gian với thì quá khứ đơn để chỉ khoảng thời gian trong quá khứ mà một sự việc đã xảy ra.

senses.definition: to have the same opinion as somebody; to say that you have the same opinion

examples.x: When he said that, I had to agree.
‘That's true’, she agreed.
I totally agree with you!
You can't expect them to agree on everything.
He agreed with them about the need for change.
Many experts agree wholeheartedly with this statement.
I tend to agree with her political views.
All parties agree (that) urgent action is required.
We agreed (that) the proposal was a good one.
‘It's terrible.’ ‘I couldn't agree more!’ (= I completely agree)

senses.definition_vi: có cùng ý kiến với ai đó; nói rằng bạn có cùng ý kiến.

senses.definition: to approve of something because you think it is morally right

examples.x: I don't agree with hitting children as a punishment.
I'm not sure I agree with the government's policy on this.

senses.definition_vi: tán thành điều gì đó vì bạn nghĩ rằng điều đó đúng về mặt đạo đức.

senses.definition: to say ‘yes’; to say that you will do what somebody wants or that you will allow something to happen

examples.x: I asked for a pay rise and she agreed.
The government has finally agreed in principle (= agreed in general but not in detail) to the terms of the deal.
Do you think he'll agree to their proposal?
She agreed (that) I could go early.
He reluctantly agreed to pay for the damage.
She agreed to let me go early.

senses.definition_vi: nói 'có'; nói rằng bạn sẽ làm những gì ai đó muốn hoặc bạn sẽ cho phép điều gì đó xảy ra.

senses.definition: to decide with somebody else to do something or to have something

examples.x: Can we agree on a date?
The new plan was agreed upon between the two sides.
They met at the agreed time.
Can we agree a price?
We agreed to meet on Thursday.
We couldn't agree what to do.
They left at ten, as agreed.

senses.definition_vi: quyết định cùng người khác làm điều gì đó hoặc có điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to officially accept a plan, request, etc.

examples.x: The company agreed a deal worth $100 million.
Next year's budget has been agreed.
We arranged to meet a few days later and agree terms.

senses.definition_vi: chính thức chấp nhận một kế hoạch, yêu cầu, v.v.

senses.definition: to be the same as something

examples.x: The figures do not agree.
Your account of the accident does not agree with hers.

senses.definition_vi: giống với một cái gì đó.

senses.definition: to match a word or phrase in number, gender or person

examples.x: In ‘Tom likes jazz’, the singular verb ‘likes’ agrees with the subject ‘Tom’.

senses.definition_vi: khớp với một từ hoặc cụm từ về số, giống hoặc ngôi.

senses.definition: if two people agree to differ/disagree, they accept that they have different opinions about something, but they decide not to discuss it any longer

examples.x: We must just agree to differ on this.
In the end we agreed to disagree.
I think you're wrong. Let's just agree to differ.

senses.definition_vi: nếu hai người đồng ý khác biệt/không đồng ý, họ chấp nhận rằng họ có ý kiến khác nhau về điều gì đó, nhưng họ quyết định không thảo luận thêm nữa.

senses.definition: an arrangement, a promise or a contract made with somebody

examples.x: an international peace agreement
The agreement (= the document recording the agreement) was signed during a meeting at the UN.
They have entered into a free trade agreement with Australia.
An agreement was finally reached between management and employees.
They had an agreement never to talk about work at home.
They had made a verbal agreement to sell.
The software is provided under a license agreement and may not be copied without permission.
The specific terms of the agreement have not been disclosed.
The documents are covered by a confidentiality agreement.

senses.definition_vi: một sự sắp xếp, một lời hứa hoặc một hợp đồng đã được thực hiện với ai đó.

senses.definition: the state of sharing the same opinion or feeling

examples.x: The two sides failed to reach agreement.
There was broad agreement on what was needed.
There is agreement among teachers that changes need to be made.
Is everybody in agreement now?
Are we in agreement about the price?

examples.cf: in agreement with somebody on/about something
examples.x: My partner is in complete agreement with me on this issue.
I am in agreement with you that she should be given more responsibilities.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái có cùng ý kiến hoặc cảm xúc với ai đó.

senses.definition: the fact of somebody approving of something and allowing it to happen

examples.x: You'll have to get your parents' agreement if you want to go on the trip.
Most pension schemes allow employees to keep working with the agreement of their employer.
No images may be reproduced without the artist's agreement.

senses.definition_vi: việc ai đó tán thành điều gì đó và cho phép nó xảy ra.

senses.definition: the state of having the same number, gender or person

examples.x: In the sentence ‘They live in the country’, the plural form of the verb ‘live’ is in agreement with the plural subject ‘they’.

senses.definition_vi: trạng thái có cùng số, giống hoặc ngôi.

senses.definition: connected with the science or practice of farming

examples.x: agricultural policy/land/production/development

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến khoa học hoặc thực hành nông nghiệp

senses.definition: the science or practice of farming

examples.x: The number of people employed in agriculture has fallen in the last decade.
50% of the country’s population depends on agriculture.

senses.definition_vi: khoa học hoặc thực hành nông nghiệp

senses.definition: used to express surprise, pleasure or sympathy, or when you disagree with somebody

examples.x: Ah, there you are!
Ah, this coffee is good.
Ah well, better luck next time.
Ah, but that may not be true.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để diễn tả sự ngạc nhiên, vui mừng hoặc đồng cảm, hoặc khi bạn không đồng ý với ai đó

senses.definition: further forward in space or time; in front

examples.x: I'll run ahead and warn them.
The road ahead was blocked.
We've got a lot of hard work ahead.
This will create problems in the months ahead.
He was looking straight ahead (= straight forward, in front of him).

senses.definition_vi: xa hơn về không gian hoặc thời gian; ở phía trước

senses.definition: earlier

examples.x: The party was planned weeks ahead.

senses.definition_vi: sớm hơn

senses.definition: winning; further advanced

examples.x: Our team was ahead by six points.
You need to work hard to keep ahead.

senses.definition_vi: thắng cuộc; tiến xa hơn

senses.definition: money, food, etc. that is sent to help countries in difficult situations

examples.x: humanitarian/food/medical aid
An extra £10 million in foreign aid has been provided for victims of the earthquake.
international aid workers

senses.definition_vi: tiền, thực phẩm, v.v. được gửi để giúp đỡ các quốc gia trong tình huống khó khăn

senses.definition: help that you need, especially to perform a particular task

examples.x: She walks with the aid of a stick.
This job would be impossible without the aid of a computer.
One of the staff saw he was in difficulty and came to his aid (= helped him).

senses.definition_vi: sự giúp đỡ bạn cần, đặc biệt là để thực hiện một nhiệm vụ cụ thể

senses.definition: an object, a machine, etc. that you use to help you do something

examples.x: Photos make useful teaching aids.

senses.definition_vi: một vật, một máy móc, v.v. mà bạn sử dụng để giúp bạn làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: in order to help something/somebody

examples.x: collecting money in aid of charity

senses.definition_vi: để giúp đỡ một cái gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: used to ask why something is happening

examples.x: What's all this crying in aid of?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để hỏi tại sao một điều gì đó đang xảy ra

senses.definition: to help somebody/something to do something, especially by making it easier

examples.x: The test is designed to aid in the diagnosis of various diseases.
The research has aided in developing new drugs.
The charity was established to aid hurricane victims.
The investigation was greatly aided by the fact that the house was equipped with CCTV cameras.
They were accused of aiding his escape.
They were accused of aiding him to escape.
They were accused of aiding him in his escape.
The strategy can aid teachers in dealing with disruptive behaviour.
Words will be displayed around the room to aid students with spelling.

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ ai đó/cái gì đó làm điều gì đó, đặc biệt là bằng cách làm cho nó dễ dàng hơn

senses.definition: to help or encourage something to happen

examples.x: New drugs are now available to aid recovery.
Some perfumes aid restful sleep.
Peppermint aids digestion.

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ hoặc khuyến khích một điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: to help somebody to do something illegal or wrong

examples.x: She stands accused of aiding and abetting the crime.
He was charged with aiding and abetting the robbers.

senses.definition_vi: giúp đỡ ai đó làm điều gì đó bất hợp pháp hoặc sai trái

senses.definition: a person who helps another person, especially a politician, in their job

examples.x: White House aides

senses.definition_vi: một người giúp đỡ người khác, đặc biệt là một chính trị gia, trong công việc của họ

senses.definition: a serious illness caused by a virus called HIV that attacks the body’s ability to resist infection (the abbreviation for ‘Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome’)

examples.x: the AIDS epidemic
to fight/eradicate/combat AIDS
people who have battled and survived AIDS
AIDS research/education
She died of an AIDs-related illness at the age of 54.

senses.definition_vi: một căn bệnh nghiêm trọng do vi rút HIV gây ra tấn công khả năng chống nhiễm trùng của cơ thể (viết tắt của ‘Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome’)

senses.definition: the purpose of doing something; what somebody is trying to achieve

examples.x: the stated aims of the study
Our main aim is to provide affordable childcare.
His sole aim in life is to enjoy himself.
Teamwork is required in order to achieve these aims.
to pursue/further/fulfil your aims
She set out the company's aims and objectives in her speech.

examples.cf: with the aim of doing something
examples.x: The organization was formed with the aim of helping local people.

senses.definition_vi: mục đích của việc làm điều gì đó; những gì ai đó đang cố gắng đạt được

senses.definition: the action or skill of pointing a weapon at somebody/something

examples.x: Her aim was good and she hit the target with her first shot.
The gunman took aim (= pointed his weapon) and fired.
His aim was poor and he missed the target.
It was a perfect aim and there was no way he would miss.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc kỹ năng nhắm vũ khí vào ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to direct your criticism at somebody/something
senses.definition_vi: nhằm mục đích chỉ trích ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to try or plan to achieve something

examples.x: He has always aimed high (= tried to achieve a lot).
We should aim for a bigger share of the market.
The team is aiming for the top this season.
Don't try to aim for perfection.
The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.
They are aiming to reduce unemployment by 50%.
The project aims to provide employment for people with learning difficulties.
We aim to be there around six.
The training programme aims at raising employees' awareness about human rights.

senses.definition_vi: cố gắng hoặc lên kế hoạch để đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have something as an aim

examples.x: The initiative is specifically aimed at helping young people.
These measures are aimed at preventing violent crime.

senses.definition_vi: có cái gì đó làm mục đích

senses.definition: to say or do something that is intended to influence or affect a particular person or group

examples.x: The courses are aimed primarily at older people.
My criticism wasn't aimed at you.
The book is aimed at very young children.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm điều gì đó có ý định ảnh hưởng hoặc tác động đến một người hoặc nhóm cụ thể

senses.definition: to point or direct a weapon, camera, shot, kick, etc. at somebody/something

examples.x: I was aiming at the tree but hit the car by mistake.
Aim for the middle of the target.
She raised one leg and aimed an almighty kick at the door.
I aimed my camera and got one shot.
He aimed the rifle in the direction of the target and fired.

senses.definition_vi: hướng hoặc nhắm vũ khí, máy ảnh, cú sút, cú đá, v.v. vào ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and that we breathe

examples.x: Let's go out for some fresh air.
a blast of hot air
currents of warm air
He stood outside, breathing the cold night air.
She was gasping for air as she ran out of the burning house.
whales coming up for air (= in order to breathe)
I need to put some air in my tyres.
The agreement requires reductions in air pollution.
The Act lays down a minimum standard for air quality.

senses.definition_vi: hỗn hợp các khí bao quanh trái đất và chúng ta hít thở

senses.definition: the space above the ground or that is around things

examples.x: Music filled the night air.
Wave your hands in the air!
I kicked the ball high into the air.
Spicy smells wafted through the air.
He punched the air in triumph.
The air was thick with cigarette smoke.

senses.definition_vi: không gian phía trên mặt đất hoặc xung quanh mọi thứ

senses.definition: the space above the earth where planes fly

examples.x: The temple was clearly visible from the air.
We watched as the helicopter took to the air.
It only takes three hours by air (= in a plane).
air travel/traffic
air defence systems (= weapons that defend against attacks from the air)
A surprise air attack (= from aircraft) was launched at night.

senses.definition_vi: không gian phía trên trái đất nơi máy bay bay

senses.definition: the particular feeling or impression that is given by somebody/something; the way somebody does something

examples.x: She looked at him with a defiant air.
The room had an air of luxury.
There was an air of complete confidence about her.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác hoặc ấn tượng cụ thể mà ai đó/cái gì đó mang lại; cách ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: a tune

examples.x: Bach’s Air on a G string

senses.definition_vi: một giai điệu

senses.definition: a way of behaving that shows that somebody thinks that they are more important, etc. than they really are

examples.x: I hate it when people put on airs.

senses.definition_vi: một cách cư xử cho thấy ai đó nghĩ rằng họ quan trọng hơn, v.v. so với thực tế

senses.definition: a way of behaving that shows that somebody thinks that they are more important, etc. than they really are

examples.x: Even when he became a star he didn’t have any airs and graces.

senses.definition_vi: một cách cư xử cho thấy ai đó nghĩ rằng họ quan trọng hơn, v.v. so với thực tế

senses.definition: clean air breathed in after being indoors or in a dirty atmosphere

examples.x: We'll get a breath of fresh air at lunchtime.
I'm going outside for a breath of fresh air.

senses.definition_vi: không khí trong lành hít vào sau khi ở trong nhà hoặc trong bầu khí quyển bẩn

senses.definition: used to say what the most important aspect of something is

examples.x: It's all about money these days.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói điều gì là khía cạnh quan trọng nhất của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to believe strongly that something should be done

examples.x: They're all for saving money where they can.

senses.definition_vi: tin tưởng mạnh mẽ rằng điều gì đó nên được thực hiện

senses.definition: to show a lot of interest in or enthusiasm for somebody

examples.x: He was all over her at the party.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện nhiều sự quan tâm hoặc nhiệt tình đối với ai đó

senses.definition: to be very attractive or impressive

examples.x: He thinks he's all that.

senses.definition_vi: rất hấp dẫn hoặc ấn tượng

senses.definition: to be the end for somebody

examples.x: It looks as though it's all up with us now (= we are ruined, have no further chances, etc.).

senses.definition_vi: là sự kết thúc đối với ai đó

senses.definition: the whole number of

examples.x: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.
Cars were coming from all directions (= every direction).
All the people you invited are coming.
All my plants have died.
All five of them are hard workers.

senses.definition_vi: toàn bộ số lượng

senses.definition: the whole amount of

examples.x: All wood tends to shrink.
You've had all the fun and I've had all the hard work.
All this mail must be answered.
He has lost all his money.

senses.definition_vi: toàn bộ số tiền

senses.definition: used with singular nouns showing something has been happening for a whole period of time

examples.x: They have worked hard all year.
She was unemployed for all that time.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với danh từ số ít chỉ điều gì đó đã xảy ra trong suốt một khoảng thời gian

senses.definition: the greatest possible

examples.x: In all honesty (= being as honest as I can), I can't agree.

senses.definition_vi: lớn nhất có thể

senses.definition: consisting or appearing to consist of one thing only

examples.x: The magazine was all advertisements.
She was all smiles (= smiling a lot).

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm hoặc dường như bao gồm chỉ một thứ

senses.definition: any whatever

examples.x: He denied all knowledge of the crime.

senses.definition_vi: bất kỳ cái nào

senses.definition: and other similar things

examples.x: I'm bored by history—dates and battles and all that stuff.

senses.definition_vi: và những thứ tương tự khác

senses.definition: despite

examples.x: For all its clarity of style, the book is not easy reading.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp

senses.definition: used to say that something is not important or of no interest or value to you/somebody

examples.x: For all I know she's still living in Boston.
You can do what you like, for all I care.
For all the good it's done we might as well not have bothered.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó không quan trọng hoặc không có hứng thú hoặc giá trị đối với bạn/ai đó

senses.definition: not particularly good, well, etc.

examples.x: He doesn't sing all that well.

senses.definition_vi: không đặc biệt tốt, ổn, v.v.

senses.definition: not as much as has been suggested

examples.x: They're not as rich as all that.
We didn't play particularly well, but we didn't do as badly as all that.

senses.definition_vi: không nhiều như đã gợi ý

senses.definition: used to express anger

examples.x: I've locked myself out. Of all the stupid things to do!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự tức giận

senses.definition: used to express surprise because somebody/something seems the least likely person, example, etc.

examples.x: I didn't think you, of all people, would become a vegetarian.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bày tỏ sự ngạc nhiên vì ai đó/điều gì đó dường như là người, ví dụ, v.v. ít có khả năng nhất

senses.definition: in or from all directions; everywhere

examples.x: We realized we were surrounded on all sides.
Disaster threatens on every side.
She was bombarded with questions from all sides.

senses.definition_vi: từ hoặc ở tất cả các hướng; khắp mọi nơi

senses.definition: the whole number or amount

examples.x: All of the food has gone.
They've eaten all of it.
They've eaten it all.
I invited some of my colleagues but not all.
Not all of them were invited.
All of them enjoyed the party.
They all enjoyed it.
His last movie was best of all.

senses.definition_vi: tổng số lượng hoặc số lượng

senses.definition: the only thing; everything

examples.x: All I want is peace and quiet.
It was all that I had.

senses.definition_vi: điều duy nhất; mọi thứ

senses.definition: most important of all; especially

examples.x: Above all, keep in touch.

senses.definition_vi: quan trọng nhất trong tất cả; đặc biệt

senses.definition: despite what has been said or expected

examples.x: So you made it after all!

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp những gì đã nói hoặc mong đợi

senses.definition: used when you are explaining something, or giving a reason

examples.x: He should have paid. He suggested it, after all.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang giải thích điều gì đó, hoặc đưa ra lý do

senses.definition: everything you have

examples.x: They gave their all (= fought and died) in the war.

senses.short_meaning_vi: tất cả những gì bạn có
senses.definition_vi: tất cả những gì bạn có

senses.definition: when everything is considered

examples.x: All in all it had been a great success.

senses.definition_vi: khi mọi thứ được xem xét

senses.definition: having two or more uses, functions, etc.

examples.x: It's a corkscrew and bottle-opener all in one.

senses.definition_vi: có hai hoặc nhiều công dụng, chức năng, v.v.

senses.definition: also; included; in addition

examples.x: She jumped into the river, clothes and all (= with her clothes on).

senses.definition_vi: cũng vậy; bao gồm; bổ sung

senses.definition: as well; too

examples.x: ‘I'm freezing.’ ‘Yeah, me and all.’

senses.definition_vi: cũng vậy; cũng

senses.definition: used to emphasize how extreme a quality or action is

examples.x: The man is guilty as all get out.
We rushed like all get out.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh mức độ cực đoan của một phẩm chất hoặc hành động

senses.definition: in any way; to any degree

examples.x: I didn't enjoy it at all.

senses.definition_vi: bằng bất kỳ cách nào; ở bất kỳ mức độ nào

senses.definition: to kill yourself
senses.definition_vi: tự sát

senses.definition: despite

examples.x: For all its clarity of style, the book is not easy reading.

senses.definition_vi: bất chấp

senses.definition: used to say that something is not important or of no interest or value to you/somebody

examples.x: For all I know she's still living in Boston.
You can do what you like, for all I care.
For all the good it's done we might as well not have bothered.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng điều gì đó không quan trọng hoặc không có hứng thú hoặc giá trị đối với bạn/ai đó

senses.definition: as a total

examples.x: There were twelve of us in all for dinner.
That's £25.40 in all.

senses.definition_vi: như một tổng số

senses.definition: used as a polite reply to an expression of thanks

examples.x: ‘Thanks very much for your help.’ ‘Not at all, it was a pleasure.’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng như một câu trả lời lịch sự cho lời cảm ơn

senses.definition: to kill yourself
senses.definition_vi: tự sát

senses.definition: a public statement that is made without giving proof, accusing somebody of doing something that is wrong or illegal

examples.x: to investigate/deny/withdraw an allegation
Several news reports made allegations of corruption within the police force.
allegations of dishonesty against him
The committee has made serious allegations about interference in its work.
an allegation that he had been dishonest

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố công khai được đưa ra mà không có bằng chứng, buộc tội ai đó làm điều gì đó sai trái hoặc bất hợp pháp

senses.definition: to state something as a fact but without giving proof

examples.x: The prosecution alleges (that) she was driving carelessly.
It is alleged that he mistreated the prisoners.

examples.cf: be alleged to be, have, etc. something
examples.x: He is alleged to have mistreated the prisoners.
This procedure should be followed in cases where dishonesty has been alleged.

senses.definition_vi: nêu điều gì đó như một sự thật nhưng không đưa ra bằng chứng

senses.definition: expressed as though something is a fact but without giving any proof

examples.x: crimes allegedly committed during the war

senses.definition_vi: được diễn đạt như thể điều gì đó là sự thật nhưng không đưa ra bất kỳ bằng chứng nào

senses.definition: an agreement between countries, political parties, etc. to work together in order to achieve something that they all want

examples.x: to form/make an alliance
The Social Democrats are now in alliance with the Greens.
an alliance between education and business to develop the use of technology in schools

senses.definition_vi: một thỏa thuận giữa các quốc gia, đảng phái chính trị, v.v. để cùng nhau làm việc nhằm đạt được điều gì đó mà tất cả họ đều muốn

senses.definition: a group of people, political parties, etc. who work together in order to achieve something that they all want

examples.x: The Green Alliance was formed to campaign against environmental damage.

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm người, đảng phái chính trị, v.v. cùng nhau làm việc nhằm đạt được điều gì đó mà tất cả họ đều muốn

senses.definition: to give something officially to somebody/something for a particular purpose

examples.x: A large sum has been allocated for buying new books for the library.
They intend to allocate more places to mature students this year.
More resources are being allocated to the project.
The project is being allocated more resources.
Millions have been allocated to improve students' performance.

senses.definition_vi: để trao một thứ gì đó chính thức cho ai đó/cái gì đó cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: an amount of money, space, etc. that is given to somebody for a particular purpose

examples.x: We have spent our entire allocation for the year.

senses.definition_vi: một số tiền, không gian, v.v. được trao cho ai đó cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: the act of giving something to somebody for a particular purpose

examples.x: the allocation of food to those who need it most

senses.definition_vi: hành động trao một thứ gì đó cho ai đó cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: to let somebody/something do something; to let something happen or be done

examples.x: His parents won't allow him to stay out late.
He allowed his mind to wander.
The law allowed companies to dismiss workers without any reason.
He is not allowed to stay out late.
Students are only allowed to use the equipment under supervision.
This research must be allowed to continue.
He refused to allow himself to be kept quiet.
She won't allow herself to be dictated to.
Eating is not allowed in the classrooms.
He received the maximum sentence allowed by law.
We do not allow eating in the classrooms.

senses.definition_vi: để cho phép ai đó/cái gì đó làm điều gì đó; để cho phép điều gì đó xảy ra hoặc được thực hiện

senses.definition: to let somebody have something

examples.x: You're allowed an hour to complete the test.
I'm not allowed visitors.
I allow myself a treat now and then.
She allowed herself a thin smile of triumph.

senses.definition_vi: để cho phép ai đó có được thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to let somebody/something go into, through, out of, etc. a place

examples.x: No dogs allowed (= you cannot bring them in).
The prisoners are allowed out of their cells for two hours a day.
They weren't allowed into the country.
He was knocking at the door waiting to be allowed in.
You won't be allowed up (= out of bed) for several days.
The crowd parted to allow her through.

senses.definition_vi: để cho phép ai đó/cái gì đó đi vào, đi qua, đi ra khỏi, v.v. một địa điểm

senses.definition: to make something possible

examples.x: A ramp allows easy access for wheelchairs.
The system allows people the opportunity to browse a wide selection of books.
The new technology allows users to choose exactly what they watch and when.

senses.definition_vi: để làm cho điều gì đó có thể

senses.definition: to make sure that you have enough of something for a particular purpose

examples.x: How much time would you allow for the trip?
You need to allow three metres of fabric for the dress.

senses.definition_vi: để đảm bảo rằng bạn có đủ thứ gì đó cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: to accept or admit something; to agree that something is true or correct

examples.x: The judge allowed my claim.
(= in a court of law) ‘Objection!’ ‘I'll allow it.’
He refuses to allow that such a situation could arise.
She was very helpful when my mother was ill—I'll allow you that.

senses.definition_vi: để chấp nhận hoặc thừa nhận điều gì đó; để đồng ý rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc chính xác

senses.definition: used to offer help politely

examples.x: ‘Allow me,’ he said, taking the tray from her.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đề nghị giúp đỡ một cách lịch sự

senses.definition: to give somebody complete freedom of action; to allow a feeling to be expressed freely

examples.x: The designer was given free rein.
The script allows full rein to her larger-than-life acting style.
When I paint I just give my imagination free rein.

senses.definition_vi: để cho phép ai đó có toàn quyền hành động; để cho phép một cảm xúc được thể hiện một cách tự do

senses.definition: an amount of money that is given to somebody regularly or for a particular purpose

examples.x: an allowance of $20 a day
a clothing/living/travel allowance
Do you get an allowance for clothing?

senses.definition_vi: một số tiền được trao cho ai đó thường xuyên hoặc cho một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: the amount of something that is allowed in a particular situation

examples.x: a baggage allowance of 20 kilos
Roman soldiers received a salt allowance, called salarium, the origin of the word salary.
The recommended daily allowance of vitamin C is 60–90 milligrams.

senses.definition_vi: số lượng của một thứ gì đó được phép trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: a small amount of money that parents give their children, usually every week or every month
senses.definition_vi: một khoản tiền nhỏ mà cha mẹ cho con cái, thường là hàng tuần hoặc hàng tháng

senses.definition: an amount of money that can be earned or received before you start paying tax

examples.x: personal tax allowances

senses.definition_vi: một khoản tiền có thể kiếm được hoặc nhận được trước khi bạn bắt đầu nộp thuế

senses.definition: to consider something, for example when you are making a decision or planning something

examples.x: The budget made allowance for inflation.
The plan makes no allowance for people working at different rates.

senses.definition_vi: để xem xét điều gì đó, ví dụ khi bạn đang đưa ra quyết định hoặc lên kế hoạch cho điều gì đó

senses.definition: to allow somebody to behave in a way that you would not usually accept, because of a problem or because there is a special reason

examples.x: You have to make allowances for him because he’s tired.

senses.definition_vi: để cho phép ai đó cư xử theo cách mà bạn thường không chấp nhận, vì có vấn đề hoặc vì có lý do đặc biệt

senses.definition: a country that has agreed to help and support another country, especially in case of a war

examples.x: our European/NATO allies
a loyal ally of the United States
Portugal is a traditional ally of England.

senses.definition_vi: một quốc gia đã đồng ý giúp đỡ và ủng hộ một quốc gia khác, đặc biệt là trong trường hợp chiến tranh

senses.definition: a person who helps and supports somebody who is in a difficult situation, especially a politician

examples.x: a close ally and friend of the prime minister
her most powerful political ally
His sister was his ally against their grandparents.

senses.definition_vi: một người giúp đỡ và ủng hộ người đang ở trong tình huống khó khăn, đặc biệt là một chính trị gia

senses.definition: a person who offers their support to a particular group of people in society that they themselves do not belong to, in order to help ensure their basic rights and ability to be happy and successful in society

examples.x: Fran has been an ally to First Nations people her whole life.
Being an ally to somebody means acting when you see an injustice.

senses.definition_vi: một người đưa ra sự ủng hộ của họ cho một nhóm người cụ thể trong xã hội mà họ không thuộc về, để giúp đảm bảo các quyền cơ bản và khả năng hạnh phúc và thành công trong xã hội của họ

senses.definition: the group of countries including the UK and the US that fought together in the First and Second World Wars

examples.x: the Western Allies

senses.definition_vi: nhóm các quốc gia bao gồm Vương quốc Anh và Hoa Kỳ đã chiến đấu cùng nhau trong Thế chiến thứ nhất và thứ hai

senses.definition: not quite

examples.x: I like almost all of them.
They'll eat almost anything.
Almost no one (= hardly anyone) believed him.
The castle is almost entirely surrounded by water.
It's a mistake they almost always make.
The painting is almost certainly a forgery.
Her handwriting is almost impossible to read.
The team faces almost certain defeat in today's match.
The workforce has almost doubled in the past ten years.
I almost forgot your birthday.
Housing has become almost as big a problem as education.
The story seems almost too strange to be true.

senses.definition_vi: không hoàn toàn

senses.definition: without any other people

examples.x: Tom is not alone in finding Rick hard to work with.
She waited until she was alone with him to speak.
He was afraid of being alone with his thoughts.
He lives alone.
She was sitting all alone in the hall.
Finally the two of us were alone together.
I don't like going out alone at night.

senses.definition_vi: không có người nào khác

senses.definition: without the help of other people or things

examples.x: It's hard bringing up children alone.
The assassin said he had acted alone.

senses.definition_vi: không có sự giúp đỡ của người khác hoặc những thứ khác

senses.definition: lonely and unhappy or without any friends

examples.x: Carol felt all alone in the world.
I've been so alone since you went away.

senses.definition_vi: cô đơn và không hạnh phúc hoặc không có bạn bè

senses.definition: used after a noun or pronoun to show that the person or thing mentioned is the only one

examples.x: You can't blame anyone else; you alone made the decision.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau một danh từ hoặc đại từ để chỉ ra rằng người hoặc vật được đề cập là người duy nhất

senses.definition: used after a noun or pronoun to emphasize one particular thing

examples.x: The shoes alone cost £200.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau một danh từ hoặc đại từ để nhấn mạnh một điều cụ thể

senses.definition: to do something without help from anyone

examples.x: Andrew decided to go it alone and start his own business.

senses.definition_vi: để làm điều gì đó mà không cần sự giúp đỡ của bất kỳ ai

senses.definition: to stop annoying somebody or trying to get their attention

examples.x: She's asked to be left alone but the press photographers follow her everywhere.
Don't touch me! Leave me alone!

senses.definition_vi: để ngừng làm phiền ai đó hoặc cố gắng thu hút sự chú ý của họ

senses.definition: to stop touching, changing, or moving something

examples.x: I've told you before—leave my things alone!

senses.definition_vi: để ngừng chạm, thay đổi hoặc di chuyển một thứ gì đó

senses.definition: used after a statement to emphasize that because the first thing is not true or possible, the next thing cannot be true or possible either

examples.x: There isn't enough room for us, let alone any guests.
I didn’t have any clothes, let alone a passport.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau một tuyên bố để nhấn mạnh rằng vì điều đầu tiên không đúng hoặc không thể, nên điều tiếp theo cũng không thể đúng hoặc không thể

senses.definition: to be independent or not connected with other people, organizations or ideas

examples.x: These islands are too small to stand alone as independent states.
The problems that research is designed to solve do not stand alone, but are part of a wider context.

senses.definition_vi: để không bị kết nối với người khác, tổ chức hoặc ý tưởng

senses.definition: to be not near other objects or buildings

examples.x: The arch once stood alone at the entrance to the castle.

senses.definition_vi: không ở gần các đối tượng hoặc tòa nhà khác

senses.definition: used to say that you will have to wait for some time to find out the result of a situation

examples.x: Only time will tell if the treatment has been successful.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn sẽ phải đợi một thời gian để biết kết quả của một tình huống

She waited until she was alone with him to speak.
He was afraid of being alone with his thoughts.

examples.x: It's hard bringing up children alone.
