She'll arrive in New York at noon.
The train arrived at the station 20 minutes late.
We didn't arrive back at the hotel until very late.
By the time I arrived on the scene, it was all over.
Pupils may be newly arrived in Britain, with little or no English.
A police officer arrived just in time to see the burglars walking out of the building.
They arrived too late to take any action.
The police arrived to arrest him.

senses.definition_vi: đến một nơi, đặc biệt là vào cuối một hành trình

senses.definition: to be brought to somebody

examples.x: A letter arrived for you this morning.
Send your application to arrive by 31 October.
We waited an hour for our lunch to arrive.
The new product will arrive on supermarket shelves (= be available) early next year.

senses.definition_vi: được đưa đến cho ai đó

senses.definition: to happen or to come, especially when you have been waiting for it

examples.x: The wedding day finally arrived.
The baby arrived (= was born) early.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra hoặc đến, đặc biệt là khi bạn đang chờ đợi nó

senses.definition: somebody has become successful

examples.x: He knew he had arrived when he was shortlisted for the Man Booker prize.
The lad has arrived as a Premiership goalkeeper.

senses.definition_vi: ai đó đã trở nên thành công

senses.definition: a thin stick with a sharp point at one end, which is shot from a bow

examples.x: a bow and arrow
to fire/shoot an arrow
The road continues as straight as an arrow.

senses.definition_vi: một que mỏng có đầu nhọn ở một đầu, được bắn từ cung

senses.definition: a mark or sign like an arrow (➞), used to show direction or position

examples.x: Follow the arrows.
Use the arrow keys to move the cursor.

senses.definition_vi: một dấu hiệu hoặc ký hiệu giống như mũi tên (➞), được sử dụng để chỉ hướng hoặc vị trí

senses.definition: the use of the imagination to express ideas or feelings, particularly in painting, drawing or sculpture

examples.x: modern/contemporary art
an art critic/historian/lover
Can we call television art?
stolen works of art
Her performance displayed great art.
American art
It's a very beautiful piece of art.

senses.definition_vi: sự sử dụng trí tưởng tượng để thể hiện ý tưởng hoặc cảm xúc, đặc biệt là trong hội họa, vẽ hoặc điêu khắc

senses.definition: examples of objects such as paintings, drawings or sculptures

examples.x: an art gallery/exhibition
a collection of art and antiques

senses.definition_vi: các ví dụ về các đối tượng như tranh vẽ, bản vẽ hoặc tác phẩm điêu khắc

senses.definition: the skill of creating objects such as paintings and drawings, especially when you study it

examples.x: She's good at art and design.
He has a master's degree in fine art.
an art teacher/student/college/class

senses.definition_vi: kỹ năng tạo ra các đối tượng như tranh vẽ và bản vẽ, đặc biệt là khi bạn nghiên cứu nó

senses.definition: art, music, theatre, literature, etc. when you think of them as a group

examples.x: lottery funding for the arts
What is the relationship between the visual arts and music?

senses.definition_vi: nghệ thuật, âm nhạc, sân khấu, văn học, v.v. khi bạn xem chúng như một nhóm

senses.definition: a type of visual or performing art

examples.x: an exhibition of Peruvian arts and crafts
Dance is a very theatrical art.

senses.definition_vi: một loại hình nghệ thuật thị giác hoặc biểu diễn

senses.definition: the subjects you can study at school or university that are not sciences, such as languages, history or literature

examples.x: an arts degree

senses.definition_vi: các môn học bạn có thể học ở trường hoặc đại học không phải là khoa học, chẳng hạn như ngôn ngữ, lịch sử hoặc văn học

senses.definition: an ability or a skill that you can develop with training and practice

examples.x: a therapist trained in the art of healing
I've never mastered the art of making bread.
Letter-writing is a lost art nowadays.
Appearing confident at interviews is quite an art (= rather difficult).

senses.definition_vi: một khả năng hoặc kỹ năng mà bạn có thể phát triển thông qua đào tạo và thực hành

senses.definition: to learn to do something well and efficiently

examples.x: I spend so much time travelling that I've got packing down to a fine art.

senses.definition_vi: học cách làm một cái gì đó một cách tốt và hiệu quả

senses.definition: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine, on a website, etc.

examples.x: to read/write/publish an article
Her comment follows an article posted online by the ‘Huffington Post’.
I read an interesting article by a well-known scientist on the subject of genetics.
Have you seen that article about young fashion designers?
According to a recent newspaper article, the company is worth over $20 billion.

senses.definition_vi: một bài viết về một chủ đề cụ thể trên báo hoặc tạp chí, trên trang web, v.v.

senses.definition: a separate item in an agreement or a contract

examples.x: Article 10 of the European Convention guarantees free speech.

senses.definition_vi: một mục riêng biệt trong một thỏa thuận hoặc hợp đồng

senses.definition: a particular item or separate thing, especially one of a set

examples.x: articles of clothing
toilet articles such as soap and shampoo
The articles left at the scene helped the police to identify the criminals.

senses.definition_vi: một món đồ hoặc một thứ riêng biệt, đặc biệt là một trong một bộ

senses.definition: the words a and an (the indefinite article) or the (the definite article)

examples.x: Names of countries in English do not usually take an article.

senses.definition_vi: các từ a và an (mạo từ bất định) hoặc the (mạo từ xác định)

senses.definition: to express or explain your thoughts or feelings clearly in words

examples.x: She struggled to articulate her thoughts.
It is the school’s duty to articulate its practices to parents.

senses.definition_vi: diễn đạt hoặc giải thích rõ ràng suy nghĩ hoặc cảm xúc của bạn bằng lời nói

senses.definition: to speak, pronounce or play something in a clear way

examples.x: He was too weak to articulate properly.
Every note was carefully articulated.
She spoke slowly, articulating each word clearly.

senses.definition_vi: phát âm hoặc chơi một cái gì đó một cách rõ ràng

senses.definition: to be related to something so that together the two parts form a whole

examples.x: These courses are designed to articulate with university degrees.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến một cái gì đó để hai phần cùng nhau tạo thành một thể thống nhất

senses.definition: to be joined to something else by a joint, so that movement is possible; to join something in this way

examples.x: bones that articulate with others
a robot with articulated limbs

senses.definition_vi: được nối với một cái gì đó khác bằng một khớp nối, để có thể cử động; nối một cái gì đó theo cách này

senses.definition: made or produced to copy something natural; not real

examples.x: an artificial limb/flower/sweetener/fertilizer
artificial lighting/light

senses.definition_vi: được tạo ra hoặc sản xuất để sao chép một cái gì đó tự nhiên; không có thật

senses.definition: created by people; not happening naturally

examples.x: A job interview is a very artificial situation.
the artificial barriers of race, class and gender

senses.definition_vi: được tạo ra bởi con người; không xảy ra tự nhiên

senses.definition: not what it appears to be

examples.x: artificial emotion

senses.definition_vi: không phải như những gì nó có vẻ

senses.definition: a person who creates works of art, especially paintings or drawings

examples.x: an exhibition of work by contemporary British artists
a graphic artist
a make-up artist
He became a full-time artist in 1929.
In Paris she met a group of young artists: poets, film-makers and painters.
This is an artist's impression of the new stadium.
Whoever made this cake is a real artist.

senses.definition_vi: một người tạo ra các tác phẩm nghệ thuật, đặc biệt là tranh vẽ hoặc bản vẽ

senses.definition: a person who is a professional singer, dancer, actor, etc.

examples.x: a recording/solo artist
Among the artistes appearing on our show tonight we have…
He was a true artiste: sensitive, dramatic and tragic.

senses.definition_vi: một người là ca sĩ, vũ công, diễn viên chuyên nghiệp, v.v.

senses.definition: connected with art or artists

examples.x: the artistic works of the period
a work of great artistic merit
an artistic temperament (= behaviour thought to be typical of artists, musicians, etc.)
Love is a time-honoured subject of literary and artistic expression.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến nghệ thuật hoặc nghệ sĩ

senses.definition: showing a natural skill or pleasure in art, especially being able to paint or draw well

examples.x: artistic abilities/achievements/skills/talent
She comes from a very artistic family.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện kỹ năng hoặc sở thích tự nhiên về nghệ thuật, đặc biệt là có khả năng vẽ hoặc phác thảo tốt

senses.definition: done with skill and imagination; attractive or beautiful

examples.x: an artistic arrangement of dried flowers
The decor inside the house was very artistic.

senses.definition_vi: được thực hiện với kỹ năng và trí tưởng tượng; hấp dẫn hoặc đẹp

senses.definition: the freedom of artists or writers to change facts in order to make a story, painting, etc. more interesting or beautiful
senses.definition_vi: quyền tự do của các nghệ sĩ hoặc nhà văn thay đổi sự kiện để làm cho một câu chuyện, bức tranh, v.v. trở nên thú vị hoặc đẹp hơn

senses.definition: pictures and photographs prepared for books, magazines, etc.

examples.x: Can you let me have the finished artwork for the poster by Friday?

senses.definition_vi: hình ảnh và ảnh được chuẩn bị cho sách, tạp chí, v.v.

senses.definition: a work of art, especially one in a museum; works of art as a group

examples.x: 30 original artworks have gone missing from the museum.
a collection of artwork from different cultures

senses.definition_vi: một tác phẩm nghệ thuật, đặc biệt là một tác phẩm trong bảo tàng; các tác phẩm nghệ thuật như một nhóm

senses.definition: used when you are comparing two people or things, or two situations

examples.x: You're as tall as your father.
He was as white as a sheet.
She doesn't play as well as her sister.
I haven't known him as long as you (= as you have known him).
He doesn't earn as much as me.
He doesn't earn as much as I do.
It's not as hard as I thought.
Run as fast as you can.
We'd like it as soon as possible.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang so sánh hai người hoặc hai vật, hoặc hai tình huống

senses.definition: used to say that something happens in the same way

examples.x: As always, he said little.
The ‘h’ in honest is silent, as in ‘hour’.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một cái gì đó xảy ra theo cùng một cách

senses.definition: used to emphasize an amount

examples.x: As many as 2 million people could be affected.
The chimp is an endangered species, with as few as 170 000 chimps left in the wild.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một số lượng

senses.definition: while something else is happening

examples.x: He sat watching her as she got ready.
As she grew older she gained in confidence.

senses.definition_vi: trong khi một cái gì đó khác đang xảy ra

senses.definition: in the way in which

examples.x: They did as I had asked.
Leave the papers as they are.
She lost it, just as I said she would.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách mà

senses.definition: used to state the reason for something

examples.x: As you were out, I left a message.
She may need some help as she's new.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nêu lý do cho một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to make a comment or to add information about what you have just said

examples.x: As you know, Julia is leaving soon.
She's very tall, as is her mother.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để đưa ra một nhận xét hoặc bổ sung thông tin về những gì bạn vừa nói

senses.definition: used to say that although something is true, what follows is also true

examples.x: Happy as they were, there was something missing.
Try as he might (= however hard he tried), he couldn't open the door.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng mặc dù một cái gì đó là đúng, những gì theo sau cũng đúng

senses.definition: in contrast with something

examples.x: They got 27 per cent of the vote as against 32 per cent at the last election.

senses.definition_vi: trái ngược với một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that something may happen at some time in the future, but only when something else has happened

examples.x: We'll decide on the team as and when we qualify.
I'll tell you more as and when (= as soon as I can).

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng một cái gì đó có thể xảy ra vào một thời điểm nào đó trong tương lai, nhưng chỉ khi một cái gì đó khác đã xảy ra

senses.definition: used to start talking about somebody/something

examples.x: As for Jo, she's doing fine.
As for food for the party, that's all being taken care of.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để bắt đầu nói về ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to show the time or date from which something starts

examples.x: Our phone number is changing as from May 12.
Lee and I are now officially engaged, as of yesterday.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ ra thời gian hoặc ngày mà một cái gì đó bắt đầu

senses.definition: in a way that suggests something

examples.x: He behaved as if nothing had happened.
It sounds as though you had a good time.
It's my birthday. As if you didn't know!
‘Don't say anything.’ ‘As if I would!’ (= surely you do not expect me to)

senses.definition_vi: theo một cách gợi ý một cái gì đó

senses.definition: used to say that you doubt something very much

examples.x: ‘He says he'll be on time tomorrow.’ ‘As if! He's always late!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng bạn rất nghi ngờ một cái gì đó

senses.definition: considering the present situation; as things are

examples.x: We were hoping to finish it by next week—as it is, it may be the week after.
I can't help—I've got too much to do as it is (= already).

senses.definition_vi: xét tình hình hiện tại; như mọi thứ vốn có

senses.definition: used when a speaker is giving his or her own impression of a situation or expressing something in a particular way

examples.x: Teachers must put the brakes on, as it were, when they notice students looking puzzled.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi người nói đưa ra ấn tượng của riêng mình về một tình huống hoặc diễn đạt một cái gì đó theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: used when you are referring to something

examples.x: As to tax, that will be deducted from your salary.
I have a few ideas as to how we might do this.
There is a serious issue as to whether or not we give tutors enough guidance.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang đề cập đến một cái gì đó

senses.definition: until now or until a particular time in the past

examples.x: an as yet unpublished report
As yet little was known of the causes of the disease.

senses.definition_vi: cho đến bây giờ hoặc cho đến một thời điểm cụ thể trong quá khứ

senses.definition: used as a comment on something that you have just said

examples.x: He smiled and I smiled back. As you do.
A little boy finds a gigantic robot in his backyard—as you do—and has to keep it secret.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng như một nhận xét về những gì bạn vừa nói

senses.definition: if you are going to be punished for doing something wrong, whether it is a big or small thing, you may as well do the big thing
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn sẽ bị trừng phạt vì làm điều gì đó sai, cho dù đó là việc lớn hay nhỏ, bạn cũng nên làm việc lớn

senses.definition: used to describe somebody/something appearing to be somebody/something else

examples.x: They were all dressed as clowns.
The bomb was disguised as a package.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả ai đó/cái gì đó xuất hiện như ai đó/cái gì đó khác

senses.definition: used to describe the fact that somebody/something has a particular job or function

examples.x: She works as a courier.
Treat me as a friend.
I respect him as a doctor.
You can use that glass as a vase.
The news came as a shock.
She had been there often as a child (= when she was a child).

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để mô tả việc ai đó/cái gì đó có một công việc hoặc chức năng cụ thể

senses.definition: the grey or black powder that is left after something, especially tobacco, wood or coal, has burnt

examples.x: cigarette ash
black volcanic ash
Ash from the volcano fell over a wide area.
She flicked ash out of the window carelessly.

senses.definition_vi: bột màu xám hoặc đen còn lại sau khi một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là thuốc lá, gỗ hoặc than, đã cháy

senses.definition: what is left after something has been destroyed by burning

examples.x: The town was reduced to ashes in the fighting.
the glowing ashes of the campfire
The fire had died to cold ashes.
The party had risen, like a phoenix, from the ashes of electoral disaster.
She had seen all her dreams turn to ashes.

senses.definition_vi: những gì còn lại sau khi một thứ gì đó bị hủy hoại bởi lửa

senses.definition: the powder that is left after a dead person’s body has been cremated (= burned)

examples.x: She wanted her ashes to be scattered at sea.

senses.definition_vi: bột còn lại sau khi thi thể người chết đã được hỏa táng (= đốt)

senses.definition: a forest tree with grey bark
senses.definition_vi: một cây rừng có vỏ màu xám

senses.definition: the hard pale wood of the ash tree
senses.definition_vi: loại gỗ cứng màu nhạt của cây tần bì

senses.definition: the letter æ, used in Old English, and as a phonetic symbol to represent the vowel sound in cat
senses.definition_vi: chữ æ, được sử dụng trong tiếng Anh cổ, và như một ký hiệu ngữ âm để biểu thị âm nguyên âm trong từ 'cat'

senses.definition: to behave in a way that shows that you are sorry for something that you have done
senses.definition_vi: cư xử theo cách thể hiện sự hối tiếc về điều gì đó đã làm

senses.definition: feeling shame or feeling embarrassed about somebody/something or because of something you have done

examples.x: She was deeply ashamed of her behaviour at the party.
Feeling depressed is nothing to be ashamed of.
We must stop being afraid or ashamed of what we are.
His clothes and manners made me ashamed of him.
You should be ashamed of yourself for telling such lies.
You ought to be thoroughly ashamed of yourselves.
I feel almost ashamed that I've been so lucky.
I am not ashamed to be a champion for women.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy xấu hổ hoặc bối rối về ai đó/điều gì đó hoặc vì điều gì đó đã làm

senses.definition: unwilling to do something because of shame or fear of feeling embarrassed

examples.x: I'm ashamed to say that I lied to her.
I cried at the end and I'm not ashamed to admit it.
He felt ashamed to let her see him in this state.
You act as if you’re ashamed to be seen with me.

senses.definition_vi: không muốn làm điều gì đó vì xấu hổ hoặc sợ bị bối rối

senses.definition: to one side; out of the way

examples.x: She pulled the curtain aside.
Stand aside and let these people pass.
He took me aside (= away from a group of people) to give me some advice.
Leaving aside (= not considering at this stage) the cost of the scheme, let us examine its benefits.
All our protests were brushed aside (= ignored).

senses.definition_vi: sang một bên; ra khỏi đường

senses.definition: to be used later

examples.x: We set aside some money for repairs.

senses.definition_vi: để sử dụng sau

senses.definition: used to say that except for one thing, something is true

examples.x: Money worries aside, things are going well.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng ngoại trừ một điều, điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information

examples.x: How old are you—if you don’t mind me/my asking?
He asked about her family.
Can I ask a question?
Did you ask the price?
You do what I tell you to, no questions asked.
There are three important questions to ask.
frequently asked questions
‘Where are you going?’ she asked.
‘Are you sure?’ he asked her.
She asked the students their names.
I often get asked that!
I had to ask myself some very difficult questions.
I'd like to ask you a few questions.
Why does everyone keep asking me that?
The interviewer asked me about my future plans.
When specifically asked about the report, she indicated she had not read it.
He asked where I lived.
I had to ask the teacher what to do next.
I was asked if/whether I could drive.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết điều gì đó dưới dạng câu hỏi, để lấy thông tin

senses.definition: to tell somebody that you would like them to do something or that you would like something to happen

examples.x: Anyone with information is asked to contact the police.
Parents with young children are asked to attend this meeting.
They were politely asked to leave the shop.
Eric asked me to marry him.
All the students were asked to complete a questionnaire.
I asked whether they could change my ticket.
She asked me if I would give her English lessons.
She asked that she be kept informed of developments.
She asked that she should be kept informed.
If you ask her nicely, she'll give you a hand.

senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng bạn muốn họ làm điều gì đó hoặc bạn muốn điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: to say that you would like somebody to give you something

examples.x: Don't be afraid to ask for help.
I am writing to ask for some information about courses.
to ask for a job/a drink/an explanation
Did your friend ask for permission to use the image?
Why don't you ask his advice?
Why don't you ask him for his advice?
Can I ask a favour of you?
Can I ask you a favour?

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn muốn ai đó cho bạn thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to request permission to do something

examples.x: I immediately asked to speak to a supervisor.
I asked to see the manager.
Did you ask to use the car?
I'll ask if it's all right to park here.
She asked her boss whether she could have the day off.

senses.definition_vi: xin phép làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to invite somebody

examples.x: They've asked me to dinner.
Thank you so much for asking me.
I didn't ask them in (= to come into the house).
We must ask the neighbours round (= to our house).
She's asked him to come to the party.

senses.definition_vi: mời ai đó

senses.definition: to request a particular amount of money for something that you are selling

examples.x: He's asking £2 000 for the car.
How much were they asking for their house?

senses.definition_vi: yêu cầu một số tiền nhất định cho thứ gì đó bạn đang bán

senses.definition: to expect or demand something

examples.x: I know I'm asking a great deal.
You're asking too much of him.
I know it's asking a lot to expect them to win again.

senses.definition_vi: mong đợi hoặc đòi hỏi điều gì đó

senses.definition: to deserve something bad that happens to you or that somebody does to you

examples.x: ‘You shouldn’t have said that to her.’ ‘Well, she asked for it!’

senses.definition_vi: xứng đáng nhận điều gì đó tồi tệ xảy ra với bạn hoặc ai đó làm với bạn

senses.definition: to behave in a way that is very likely to result in trouble

examples.x: He was asking for trouble when he insulted their country.

senses.definition_vi: cư xử theo cách rất có thể dẫn đến rắc rối

senses.definition: if you say don’t ask to somebody, you mean that you do not want to reply to their question, because it would be difficult to explain, embarrassing, etc.

examples.x: ‘And what did he do then?’ ‘Don’t ask!’

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói 'đừng hỏi' với ai đó, bạn có nghĩa là bạn không muốn trả lời câu hỏi của họ, vì nó sẽ khó giải thích, khó xử, v.v.

senses.definition: if you say don’t ask me, you mean that you do not know the answer to a question and are annoyed you have been asked

examples.x: ‘What will the meeting be about?’ ‘Don’t ask me.’

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói 'đừng hỏi tôi', bạn có nghĩa là bạn không biết câu trả lời cho một câu hỏi và khó chịu vì đã bị hỏi

senses.definition: if you can have something for the asking, it is very easy for you to get it if you ask for it

examples.x: The job is yours for the asking.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói bạn có thể có được thứ gì đó 'chỉ cần hỏi', điều đó có nghĩa là rất dễ dàng để bạn có được nó nếu bạn yêu cầu

senses.definition: if you say I ask you, you are expressing shock, anger or a strong feeling of dislike about something/somebody

examples.x: He told me I had to work late on Friday night. I ask you!

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói 'tôi hỏi bạn', bạn đang bày tỏ sự sốc, tức giận hoặc cảm giác ghê tởm mạnh mẽ về điều gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: in my personal opinion

examples.x: Their marriage was a mistake, if you ask me.

senses.definition_vi: theo ý kiến cá nhân của tôi

senses.definition: sleeping

examples.x: I waited until they were all fast asleep (= sleeping deeply).
The baby was sound asleep (= sleeping deeply) upstairs.
He was so exhausted that he fell asleep at his desk.
My mother fell asleep at the wheel (= while driving) and crashed into a tree.
She was still half asleep (= not fully awake) when she arrived at work.
The police found him asleep in a garage.

senses.definition_vi: đang ngủ

senses.definition: used to describe a part of the body that has no feeling in it, usually because it has been in the same position for too long

examples.x: I couldn't move straight away, as my leg was completely asleep.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để mô tả một bộ phận cơ thể không có cảm giác, thường là do nó ở cùng một vị trí quá lâu

senses.definition: not paying enough attention to what you need to do

examples.x: They were asleep on the job as the financial crisis deepened.
Let's hope the regulators are not asleep at the wheel.
Somebody must have been asleep at the switch to allow this to happen.

senses.definition_vi: không chú ý đủ đến những gì bạn cần làm

senses.definition: a particular part or feature of a situation, an idea, a problem, etc.; a way in which it may be considered

examples.x: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.
The exhibition will focus on various aspects of life and culture in the Middle Ages.
the most important aspect of the debate
She felt she had looked at the problem from every aspect.
This was one aspect of her character he hadn't seen before.
We have worked very hard on certain aspects of our game.
The consultancy gives advice to manufacturers on the health and safety aspects of their products.

senses.definition_vi: một phần hoặc đặc điểm cụ thể của một tình huống, một ý tưởng, một vấn đề, v.v.; một cách xem xét nó

senses.definition: the appearance of a place, a situation or a person

examples.x: Events began to take on a more sinister aspect.
the dirty and seedy aspect of the bar

senses.definition_vi: vẻ ngoài của một địa điểm, một tình huống hoặc một người

senses.definition: the direction in which a building, window, piece of land, etc. faces; the side of a building that faces a particular direction

examples.x: Our room had a western aspect.
The southern aspect of the school was dominated by the mountain.

senses.definition_vi: hướng mà một tòa nhà, cửa sổ, mảnh đất, v.v. đối diện; mặt của một tòa nhà hướng về một hướng cụ thể

senses.definition: the form of a verb that shows, for example, whether the action happens once or repeatedly, is completed or still continuing
senses.definition_vi: hình thức của động từ cho biết, ví dụ, liệu hành động xảy ra một lần hay lặp đi lặp lại, đã hoàn thành hay vẫn đang tiếp diễn

senses.definition: a strong desire to have or do something

examples.x: I didn't realize you had political aspirations.
He has never had any aspiration to earn a lot of money.
What changes are needed to meet women's aspirations for employment?

senses.definition_vi: một mong muốn mạnh mẽ để có hoặc làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: the action of pronouncing a word with a breath that can be heard, as in the /h/ sound in house in English
senses.definition_vi: hành động phát âm một từ với một hơi thở có thể nghe thấy, như trong âm /h/ trong từ 'house' trong tiếng Anh

senses.definition: to have a strong desire to achieve or to become something

examples.x: She aspired to a scientific career.
He aspired to be their next leader.

senses.definition_vi: có một mong muốn mạnh mẽ để đạt được hoặc trở thành một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the murder of an important or famous person, especially for political reasons

examples.x: The president survived a number of assassination attempts.
the assassination of John F. Kennedy

senses.definition_vi: vụ giết một người quan trọng hoặc nổi tiếng, đặc biệt vì lý do chính trị

senses.definition: the crime of attacking somebody physically

examples.x: Both men were charged with assault.
sexual assaults
A significant number of indecent assaults on women go unreported.

senses.definition_vi: tội hành hung ai đó về thể chất

senses.definition: the act of attacking a building, an area, etc. in order to take control of it

examples.x: An assault on the capital was launched in the early hours of the morning.

senses.definition_vi: hành động tấn công một tòa nhà, một khu vực, v.v. để giành quyền kiểm soát nó

senses.definition: the act of trying to achieve something that is difficult or dangerous

examples.x: The government has mounted a new assault on unemployment.
a two-year legal assault on alleged tax fraud
Three people died during an assault on the mountain (= while trying to climb it).

senses.definition_vi: hành động cố gắng đạt được điều gì đó khó khăn hoặc nguy hiểm

senses.definition: an act of criticizing somebody/something severely

examples.x: The suggested closures came under assault from all parties.
The paper's assault on the president was totally unjustified.

senses.definition_vi: hành động chỉ trích ai đó/điều gì đó một cách nghiêm khắc

senses.definition: an act that threatens to harm somebody physically, whether or not actual harm is done
senses.definition_vi: một hành động đe dọa làm hại ai đó về thể chất, bất kể có gây hại thực tế hay không

senses.definition: to attack somebody violently, especially when this is a crime

examples.x: He has been charged with assaulting a police officer.
Four women have been sexually assaulted in the area recently.
He admitted indecently assaulting three men.
Many healthcare workers say they have been physically assaulted by patients.

senses.definition_vi: tấn công ai đó một cách bạo lực, đặc biệt là khi đó là một tội ác

senses.definition: to affect your senses in a way that is very unpleasant or uncomfortable

examples.x: Loud rock music assaulted our ears.

senses.definition_vi: ảnh hưởng đến các giác quan của bạn theo cách rất khó chịu hoặc bất tiện

senses.definition: to come together as a group; to bring people or things together as a group

examples.x: All the students were asked to assemble in the main hall.
She then addressed the assembled company (= all the people there).
to assemble evidence/data
The manager has assembled a world-class team.
He tried to assemble his thoughts.

senses.definition_vi: tập hợp lại thành một nhóm; đưa mọi người hoặc mọi thứ lại thành một nhóm

senses.definition: to fit together all the separate parts of something, for example a piece of furniture

examples.x: The shelves are easy to assemble.

senses.definition_vi: lắp ráp tất cả các bộ phận riêng lẻ của một cái gì đó, ví dụ như một món đồ nội thất

senses.definition: a group of people who have been elected to meet together regularly and make decisions or laws for a particular region or country

examples.x: state/legislative/federal/local assemblies
Power has been handed over to provincial and regional assemblies.
The national assembly has voted to adopt the budget.
the California Assembly
the UN General Assembly
assembly elections
an elected assembly

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm người đã được bầu để họp mặt thường xuyên và đưa ra quyết định hoặc luật pháp cho một khu vực hoặc quốc gia cụ thể

senses.definition: the meeting together of a group of people for a particular purpose; a group of people who meet together for a particular purpose

examples.x: They were fighting for freedom of speech and freedom of assembly.
He was to address a public assembly on the issue.
an assembly point (= a place where people have been asked to meet)

senses.definition_vi: cuộc họp mặt của một nhóm người vì một mục đích cụ thể; một nhóm người họp mặt vì một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: a meeting of the teachers and students in a school, usually at the start of the day, to give information, discuss school events or say prayers together

examples.x: The deputy head was taking (= leading) school assembly that day.

senses.definition_vi: cuộc họp mặt của giáo viên và học sinh trong trường, thường vào đầu ngày, để cung cấp thông tin, thảo luận về các sự kiện của trường hoặc cùng nhau cầu nguyện

senses.definition: the process of putting together the parts of something such as a vehicle or piece of furniture

examples.x: Putting the bookcase together should be a simple assembly job.
a car assembly plant
the correct assembly of the parts

senses.definition_vi: quá trình lắp ráp các bộ phận của một cái gì đó như xe cộ hoặc đồ nội thất

senses.definition: to state clearly and definitely that something is true

examples.x: She continued to assert that she was innocent.
The report asserts confidently that the industry will grow.
She continued to assert her innocence.
The German Chancellor was anxious to assert his government's commitment to European unity.
‘That is wrong,’ he asserted.
It is commonly asserted that older people prefer to receive care from family members.

senses.definition_vi: nói rõ ràng và dứt khoát rằng điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: to behave in a confident and determined way so that other people pay attention to your opinions

examples.x: You’re too timid—you must try to assert yourself more.

senses.definition_vi: hành xử một cách tự tin và quyết đoán để người khác chú ý đến ý kiến của bạn

senses.definition: to make other people recognize your right or authority to do something, by behaving in a determined and confident way

examples.x: to assert your independence/rights
I was determined to assert my authority from the beginning.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho người khác nhận ra quyền hoặc thẩm quyền của bạn để làm điều gì đó, bằng cách hành xử một cách quyết đoán và tự tin

senses.definition: to start to have an effect

examples.x: Good sense asserted itself.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu có tác dụng

senses.definition: a statement saying that you strongly believe something to be true

examples.x: He was correct in his assertion that the minister had been lying.
Do you have any evidence to support your assertions?

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố nói rằng bạn tin chắc điều gì đó là đúng

senses.definition: the act of stating, using or claiming something strongly

examples.x: the assertion of his authority
The demonstration was an assertion of the right to peaceful protest.

senses.definition_vi: hành động tuyên bố, sử dụng hoặc yêu cầu điều gì đó một cách mạnh mẽ

senses.definition: to make a judgement about the nature or quality of somebody/something

examples.x: Accurately assessing environmental impacts is very complex.
to assess a patient’s needs
It's difficult to assess the effects of these changes.
Interviews allow you to assess the suitability of candidates.
She engaged a safety consultant to assess the risks.
Quality of life was assessed using a questionnaire.
The young men were assessed as either safe or unsafe drivers.
I'd assess your chances as low.
The committee assesses whether a building is worth preserving.
We are trying to assess how well the system works.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một phán đoán về bản chất hoặc chất lượng của ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: to calculate the amount or value of something

examples.x: They have assessed the amount of compensation to be paid.
Damage to the building was assessed at £40 000.

senses.definition_vi: tính toán số lượng hoặc giá trị của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: an opinion or a judgement about somebody/something that has been thought about very carefully

examples.x: a detailed assessment of the risks involved
An adequate environmental impact assessment was not carried out on the bypass project.
We conducted the initial assessments defining the scope of work.
The city hired them to do a structural assessment of the damage.
his assessment of the situation

senses.definition_vi: một ý kiến hoặc một phán đoán về ai đó/cái gì đó đã được suy nghĩ rất kỹ lưỡng

senses.definition: the act of judging or forming an opinion about somebody/something

examples.x: Objective assessment of the severity of the problem was difficult.
Needs assessment is crucial if the hospital is to deliver effective healthcare.

senses.definition_vi: hành động phán xét hoặc hình thành ý kiến về ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: the process of testing students and making a judgement about their knowledge, ability or progress

examples.x: written exams and other forms of assessment

senses.definition_vi: quá trình kiểm tra học sinh và đưa ra phán đoán về kiến thức, khả năng hoặc sự tiến bộ của họ

senses.definition: an amount that has been calculated and that must be paid

examples.x: a tax assessment

senses.definition_vi: một số tiền đã được tính toán và phải thanh toán

senses.definition: a person or thing that is valuable or useful to somebody/something

examples.x: In his job, patience is an invaluable asset.
Being able to speak a foreign language is a major asset.
I’m not sure if his forcefulness is an asset or a liability.
She'll be an asset to the team.

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc vật có giá trị hoặc hữu ích cho ai đó/cái gì đó

senses.definition: a thing of value, especially property, that a person or company owns, which can be used or sold to pay debts

examples.x: the net asset value of the company
Her assets include shares in the company and a house in France.
asset sales/management
income from fixed asset investments
financial/capital assets
to freeze a country’s assets

senses.definition_vi: một thứ có giá trị, đặc biệt là tài sản, mà một người hoặc công ty sở hữu, có thể được sử dụng hoặc bán để trả nợ

senses.definition: to give somebody something that they can use, or some work or responsibility

examples.x: The teacher assigned a different task to each of the children.
The two large classrooms have been assigned to us.
We have been assigned the two large classrooms.
The teacher assigned each of the children a different task.

senses.definition_vi: giao cho ai đó thứ gì đó họ có thể sử dụng, hoặc một công việc hoặc trách nhiệm

senses.definition: to provide a person for a particular task or position

examples.x: They've assigned their best man to the job.
Two senior officers have been assigned to the case.
British forces have been assigned to help with peacekeeping.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp một người cho một nhiệm vụ hoặc vị trí cụ thể

senses.definition: to send a person to work under the authority of somebody or in a particular group

examples.x: I was assigned to B platoon.
He was assigned to the Royal Canadian Navy in 1975.

senses.definition_vi: gửi một người làm việc dưới quyền của ai đó hoặc trong một nhóm cụ thể

senses.definition: to say that something has a particular value or function, or happens at a particular time or place

examples.x: Assign a different colour to each different type of information.
The painting cannot be assigned an exact date.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng một cái gì đó có một giá trị hoặc chức năng cụ thể, hoặc xảy ra vào một thời điểm hoặc địa điểm cụ thể

senses.definition: to say that your property or rights now belong to somebody else

examples.x: The agreement assigns copyright to the publisher.
She has assigned the lease to her daughter.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng tài sản hoặc quyền của bạn giờ đây thuộc về người khác

senses.definition: to be said to have a particular gender when you are born

examples.x: They were assigned male at birth but identify as female.

senses.definition_vi: được cho là có một giới tính cụ thể khi sinh ra

senses.definition: a task or piece of work that somebody is given to do, usually as part of their job or studies

examples.x: Students are required to complete all homework assignments.
You will need to complete three written assignments per semester.
a business/special assignment
I had set myself a tough assignment.
She is in Greece on an assignment for a media company.
one of our reporters on assignment in China

senses.definition_vi: một nhiệm vụ hoặc công việc mà ai đó được giao làm, thường là một phần công việc hoặc học tập của họ

senses.definition: the act of giving something to somebody; the act of giving somebody a particular task

examples.x: his assignment to other duties in the same company

senses.definition_vi: hành động giao một cái gì đó cho ai đó; hành động giao cho ai đó một nhiệm vụ cụ thể

senses.definition: to help somebody to do something

examples.x: Anyone willing to assist can contact this number.
He assisted in the development of the business strategy.
We are looking for people who would be willing to assist in the group's work.
We'll do all we can to assist you.
They will be ably assisted by our remarkable staff.
The play was directed by Mike Johnson, assisted by Sharon Gale.
His task is to advise and assist his colleagues.
We will assist you in finding somewhere to live.
Two men are assisting the police with their enquiries (= are being questioned by the police).
The driver has been assisting police with their investigation.
a course to assist adults to return to the labour market

senses.definition_vi: giúp ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to help something to happen more easily

examples.x: activities that will assist the decision-making process

senses.definition_vi: giúp một cái gì đó xảy ra dễ dàng hơn

senses.definition: help or support

examples.x: technical/economic/military assistance
financial assistance for people on low incomes
Can I be of any assistance?
Despite his cries, no one came to his assistance.
The other passengers went to her assistance.
He can only walk with the assistance of crutches.
She offered me practical assistance with my research.

examples.cf: assistance in doing something/to do something
examples.x: The company provides advice and assistance in finding work.

senses.definition_vi: sự giúp đỡ hoặc hỗ trợ

senses.definition: having a rank below that of a senior person and helping them in their work

examples.x: the assistant manager/director/commissioner
She is an assistant professor of psychology at Ohio State University.
Assistant Chief Constable Owen
Assistant Attorney General William Weld
a former assistant Secretary of State
an assistant coach/editor

senses.definition_vi: có cấp bậc dưới người cấp cao và giúp đỡ họ trong công việc

senses.definition: a person who helps or supports somebody, usually in their job

examples.x: My assistant will now demonstrate the machine in action.
a senior research assistant
I work part-time as a classroom assistant in my local primary school.
She was working as a special assistant to the president.

senses.definition_vi: một người giúp đỡ hoặc hỗ trợ ai đó, thường là trong công việc của họ

senses.definition: a person whose job is to serve customers in a shop

examples.x: an assistant in a department store
Maybe one of our assistants can help you make your choice?

senses.definition_vi: một người có nhiệm vụ phục vụ khách hàng trong cửa hàng

senses.definition: a student at university or college who spends time in a foreign country teaching his or her own language in a school
senses.definition_vi: một sinh viên đại học hoặc cao đẳng dành thời gian ở nước ngoài để dạy ngôn ngữ của mình tại một trường học

senses.definition: to make a connection between people or things in your mind

examples.x: I always associate the smell of baking with my childhood.
He is closely associated in the public mind with horror movies.
Most people immediately associate addictions with drugs and alcohol.
You wouldn’t normally associate these two writers—their styles are completely different.

senses.definition_vi: kết nối mọi người hoặc mọi thứ trong tâm trí bạn

senses.definition: to spend time with somebody, especially a person or people that somebody else does not approve of

examples.x: I don't like you associating with those people.

senses.definition_vi: dành thời gian với ai đó, đặc biệt là một người hoặc những người mà người khác không chấp thuận

senses.definition: to show that you support or agree with something

examples.x: I associate myself with the prime minister's remarks (= I agree with them).
I have never associated myself with political extremism.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện rằng bạn ủng hộ hoặc đồng ý với điều gì đó

senses.definition: if one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other

examples.x: the risks associated with taking drugs
Exposure to the sun is strongly associated with an increase in the incidence of skin cancer.
The conference will address the broad issues associated with E-commerce.
The following factors were significantly associated with chronic fatigue.
Lack of confidence is not something normally associated with a high-flying sales executive.
Salaries and associated costs have risen substantially.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một thứ gì đó liên quan đến thứ khác, hai thứ đó có mối liên hệ vì chúng xảy ra cùng nhau hoặc một thứ gây ra thứ kia

senses.definition: if a person is associated with an organization, etc. they support it

examples.x: He no longer wished to be associated with the party's policy on education.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một người liên quan đến một tổ chức, v.v. thì họ ủng hộ nó

senses.definition: used in the name of a business company that is made up of a number of smaller companies

examples.x: Associated British Foods

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng trong tên của một doanh nghiệp bao gồm một số công ty nhỏ hơn

senses.definition: an official group of people who have joined together for a particular purpose

examples.x: Do you belong to any professional or trade associations?
a residents’ association
The association meets/meet four times a year.

senses.definition_vi: một nhóm người chính thức đã tham gia vì một mục đích cụ thể

senses.definition: a connection or relationship between people or organizations

examples.x: They have maintained a close association with a college in the US.
his alleged association with terrorist groups
She became famous through her association with the group of poets.
The book was published in association with (= together with) English Heritage.
The competition was organized in association with the Government's anti-drugs initiative.
The letter was a clumsy attempt to establish guilt by association.

senses.definition_vi: một mối liên hệ hoặc mối quan hệ giữa mọi người hoặc các tổ chức

senses.definition: an idea or a memory that is suggested by somebody/something; a mental connection between ideas

examples.x: The seaside had all sorts of pleasant associations with childhood holidays for me.
The cat soon made the association between human beings and food.
Incense always had associations with religion for him.

senses.definition_vi: một ý tưởng hoặc một ký ức được gợi ý bởi ai đó/điều gì đó; một kết nối tinh thần giữa các ý tưởng

senses.definition: a connection between things where one is caused by the other

examples.x: Studies have shown strong associations between housing conditions and health.
a proven association between passive smoking and cancer
The study found a significant association between exposure to electromagnetic fields and the disease.
cases of cancer found in association with colitis

senses.definition_vi: một mối liên hệ giữa các sự vật mà một trong số đó là nguyên nhân của cái kia

senses.definition: to think or accept that something is true but without having proof of it

examples.x: It is reasonable to assume (that) the economy will continue to improve.
It's probably safe to assume (that) we'll be hearing more about this story.
Let us assume for a moment that the plan succeeds.
She would, he assumed, be home at the usual time.
It is generally assumed that stress is caused by too much work.
Don't always assume the worst (= that something bad has happened).
In this example we have assumed a unit price of $10.
I had assumed him to be a Belgian.

senses.definition_vi: cho rằng hoặc chấp nhận rằng điều gì đó là đúng nhưng không có bằng chứng về nó

senses.definition: to take or begin to have power or responsibility

examples.x: Rebel forces have assumed control of the capital.
The court assumed responsibility for the girl's welfare.
Goodman will assume the role of president.
Lynch assumed office in April.

senses.definition_vi: chiếm hoặc bắt đầu có quyền lực hoặc trách nhiệm

senses.definition: to begin to have a particular quality or appearance

examples.x: This matter has assumed considerable importance.
In the story the god assumes the form of an eagle.

senses.definition_vi: bắt đầu có một phẩm chất hoặc vẻ ngoài cụ thể

senses.definition: to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality

examples.x: He assumed an air of concern.
He had assumed a stage Southern accent.

senses.definition_vi: giả vờ có một cảm giác hoặc phẩm chất cụ thể

senses.definition: a belief or feeling that something is true or that something will happen, although there is no proof

examples.x: an underlying/implicit assumption
We need to challenge some of the basic assumptions of Western philosophy.
We are working on the assumption that everyone invited will turn up.
It was impossible to make assumptions about people's reactions.
His actions were based on a false assumption.
She arrived at college with a whole set of assumptions inherited from her family.

senses.definition_vi: một niềm tin hoặc cảm giác rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc điều gì đó sẽ xảy ra, mặc dù không có bằng chứng

senses.definition: the act of taking or beginning to have power or responsibility

examples.x: their assumption of power/control
the assumption of responsibility by the government for the disaster

senses.definition_vi: hành động chiếm hoặc bắt đầu có quyền lực hoặc trách nhiệm

senses.definition: a statement that something will certainly be true or will certainly happen, particularly when there has been doubt about it

examples.x: They called for assurances that the government is committed to its education policy.
Unemployment seems to be rising, despite repeated assurances to the contrary.

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn sẽ đúng hoặc chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra, đặc biệt là khi đã có nghi ngờ về nó

senses.definition: belief in your own abilities or strengths

examples.x: There was an air of easy assurance about him.
It was good to see some of her old assurance coming back.

senses.definition_vi: niềm tin vào khả năng hoặc điểm mạnh của chính bạn

senses.definition: a type of insurance in which money is paid out when somebody dies or after an agreed period of time

examples.x: a life assurance company
We bought a life assurance policy.

senses.definition_vi: một loại bảo hiểm trong đó tiền được chi trả khi ai đó chết hoặc sau một khoảng thời gian đã thỏa thuận

senses.definition: to tell somebody that something is definitely true or is definitely going to happen, especially when they have doubts about it

examples.x: You think I did it deliberately, but I assure you (that) I did not.
Let me assure you that I will try to help you.
We were assured that everything possible was being done.
She's perfectly safe, I can assure you.
We assured him of our support.
I won’t let you down, I can assure you of that.
‘He'll come back,’ Susan assured her.

senses.definition_vi: nói với ai đó rằng điều gì đó chắc chắn là đúng hoặc chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra, đặc biệt là khi họ có nghi ngờ về điều đó

senses.definition: to make yourself certain about something

examples.x: He assured himself of her safety.
She assured herself that the letter was still in the drawer.

senses.definition_vi: tự làm cho mình chắc chắn về điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make something certain to happen

examples.x: Victory would assure a place in the finals.
Victory would assure them a place in the finals.
This achievement has assured her a place in the history books.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho điều gì đó chắc chắn xảy ra

senses.definition: to insure something, especially against somebody’s death

examples.x: What is the sum assured?

senses.definition_vi: bảo hiểm một cái gì đó, đặc biệt là chống lại cái chết của ai đó

senses.definition: very surprising; difficult to believe

examples.x: She ran 100m in an astonishing 10.6 seconds.
I find it absolutely astonishing that you didn't like it.

senses.definition_vi: rất đáng ngạc nhiên; khó tin

senses.definition: protection that a government gives to people who have left their own country, usually because they were in danger for political reasons

examples.x: to seek/apply for/be granted asylum
There was a nationwide debate on whether the asylum laws should be changed.

senses.definition_vi: sự bảo vệ mà chính phủ dành cho những người đã rời khỏi đất nước của họ, thường là vì họ gặp nguy hiểm vì lý do chính trị

senses.definition: a hospital where people who were mentally ill could be cared for, often for a long time
senses.definition_vi: một bệnh viện nơi những người bị bệnh tâm thần có thể được chăm sóc, thường là trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: used to say where something/somebody is or where something happens

examples.x: at the corner of the street
We changed at Crewe.
They arrived late at the airport.
At the roundabout take the third exit.
I'll be at home all morning.
She's at Tom's (= at Tom's house).
I met her at the hospital.
How many people were there at the concert?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói nơi nào đó/ai đó đang ở hoặc điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: used to say where somebody works or studies

examples.x: He's been at the bank longer than anyone else.
She's at Yale (= Yale University).

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói nơi nào đó ai đó làm việc hoặc học tập

senses.definition: used to say when something happens

examples.x: We left at 2 o'clock.
at the end of the week
We woke at dawn.
I didn't know at the time of writing (= when I wrote).
At night you can see the stars.
What are you doing at the weekend?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói khi nào điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: used to state the age at which somebody does something

examples.x: She got married at 25.
He left school at the age of 16.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ độ tuổi mà ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: in the direction of or towards somebody/something

examples.x: What are you looking at?
He pointed the gun at the target.
Somebody threw paint at the prime minister.

senses.definition_vi: theo hướng hoặc hướng về ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: used after a verb to show that somebody tries to do something, or partly does something, but does not succeed or complete it

examples.x: He clutched wildly at the rope as he fell.
She nibbled at a sandwich (= ate only small bits of it).

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng sau một động từ để chỉ ra rằng ai đó cố gắng làm điều gì đó, hoặc làm một phần điều gì đó, nhưng không thành công hoặc không hoàn thành nó

senses.definition: used with adjectives to show how well somebody does something

examples.x: I'm good at French.
She's hopeless at managing people.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với tính từ để chỉ mức độ tốt mà ai đó làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to show a rate, speed, etc.

examples.x: He was driving at 70 mph.
The noise came at two-minute intervals (= once every two minutes).
Prices start at $1 000.
The book retails at £19.95.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ tỷ lệ, tốc độ, v.v.

senses.definition: used to state the distance away from something

examples.x: I held it at arm's length.
Can you read a car number plate at fifty metres?

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ khoảng cách xa điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to show the situation somebody/something is in, what somebody is doing or what is happening

examples.x: The country is now at war.
I felt at a disadvantage.
I think Mr Harris is at lunch.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để chỉ tình huống mà ai đó/điều gì đó đang ở, những gì ai đó đang làm hoặc những gì đang xảy ra

senses.definition: used to say that somebody/something is as good, bad, etc. as they can be

examples.x: This was Osaka at her best.
The garden's at its most beautiful in June.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng ai đó/điều gì đó tốt, tệ, v.v. như họ có thể

senses.definition: used with adjectives to show the cause of something

examples.x: They were impatient at the delay.
She was delighted at the result.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng với tính từ để chỉ nguyên nhân của điều gì đó

senses.definition: in response to something

examples.x: They attended the dinner at the chairman's invitation.

senses.definition_vi: để đáp lại điều gì đó

senses.definition: used when giving a phone number

examples.x: You can reach me at 637-2335, extension 354.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi cung cấp số điện thoại

senses.definition: the symbol (@) used in email addresses
senses.definition_vi: ký hiệu (@) được sử dụng trong địa chỉ email

senses.definition: used when you are giving an extra piece of information

examples.x: He managed to buy a car after all—and a nice one at that.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn cung cấp thêm thông tin

senses.definition: to be doing something, especially something bad

examples.x: Look at all that graffiti—those kids have been at it again.

senses.definition_vi: đang làm một việc gì đó, đặc biệt là điều xấu

senses.definition: a place or an activity that is very popular or fashionable

examples.x: Judging by the crowds waiting to get in, this seems to be where it's at.

senses.definition_vi: một địa điểm hoặc một hoạt động rất phổ biến hoặc thời thượng

senses.definition: a person who competes in sports

examples.x: Olympic athletes
Depression is thought to be common among elite athletes.
a training facility for amateur and professional athletes
Her company is designing part of the Olympic athletes' village.

senses.definition_vi: một người thi đấu thể thao

senses.definition: a person who competes in sports such as running, jumping and throwing

examples.x: He played baseball and basketball and excelled as a track athlete.
She was hailed as the greatest female athlete in the world.

senses.definition_vi: một người thi đấu các môn thể thao như chạy, nhảy và ném

senses.definition: a person who is good at sports and physical exercise

examples.x: She is a natural athlete.

senses.definition_vi: một người giỏi thể thao và tập thể dục

senses.definition: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth

examples.x: Wind power doesn't release carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
greenhouse gases in the earth's atmosphere
Volcanoes and hot springs can emit methane into the atmosphere.
the upper atmosphere
pollution of the atmosphere

senses.definition_vi: hỗn hợp các khí bao quanh trái đất

senses.definition: a mixture of gases that surrounds another planet or a star

examples.x: Saturn’s atmosphere
The probe will plunge into the planet's stormy atmosphere.
The outermost part of the sun's atmosphere is called the corona.

senses.definition_vi: một hỗn hợp các khí bao quanh một hành tinh hoặc một ngôi sao khác

senses.definition: the air in a room or in a small space; the air around a place

examples.x: a smoky/stuffy atmosphere
These plants love warm, humid atmospheres.

senses.definition_vi: không khí trong phòng hoặc trong không gian nhỏ; không khí xung quanh một địa điểm

senses.definition: the feeling or mood that you have in a particular place or situation; a feeling between two people or in a group of people

examples.x: Before the parade, the atmosphere was electric.
This type of lighting creates a relaxing atmosphere.
City officials have created an atmosphere of fear.
Use music and lighting to create a romantic atmosphere.
There was an atmosphere of mutual trust between them.
The old house is full of atmosphere (= it's very interesting).
The children grew up in an atmosphere of violence and insecurity.
a party atmosphere
The hotel offers a friendly atmosphere and personal service.

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác hoặc tâm trạng bạn có ở một địa điểm hoặc tình huống cụ thể; một cảm giác giữa hai người hoặc trong một nhóm người

senses.definition: a situation when people do not say anything, but feel embarrassed or uncomfortable
senses.definition_vi: một tình huống khi mọi người không nói gì, nhưng cảm thấy bối rối hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: a cruel and violent act, especially in a war

examples.x: In the war, both sides committed atrocities.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động tàn bạo và bạo lực, đặc biệt là trong chiến tranh

senses.definition: to fasten or join one thing to another

examples.x: I attach a copy of my notes for your information.
A copy of his document is attached as Appendix 3 at the end of this book.
Attach the coupon to the front of your letter.
They have attached a number of conditions to the agreement (= said that the conditions must be part of the agreement)

senses.definition_vi: buộc hoặc nối một thứ với thứ khác

senses.definition: to send an electronic document with an email

examples.x: I attach a copy of the spreadsheet.
I am attaching the image as a PDF file.

senses.definition_vi: gửi một tài liệu điện tử cùng với email

senses.definition: to believe that something is important or worth thinking about

examples.cf: attach importance, significance, value, weight to something
examples.x: I attach great importance to this research.
I wouldn't attach too much weight to these findings.

senses.definition_vi: tin rằng một điều gì đó là quan trọng hoặc đáng để suy nghĩ

senses.definition: to join somebody for a time, sometimes when you are not welcome or have not been invited

examples.x: He attached himself to me at the party and I couldn't get rid of him.

senses.definition_vi: đi cùng ai đó trong một thời gian, đôi khi khi bạn không được chào đón hoặc chưa được mời

senses.definition: to be connected with somebody/something; to connect something to something

examples.x: No one is suggesting that any health risks attach to this product.
No blame attaches to you.
This does not attach any blame to you.
Nowadays, there is less stigma attached to mental illness than in the past.

senses.definition_vi: được kết nối với ai đó/điều gì đó; kết nối một thứ với một thứ khác

senses.definition: a document that you send to somebody using email

examples.x: No attachment was included.

senses.definition_vi: một tài liệu bạn gửi cho ai đó qua email

senses.definition: the act of joining one thing to another; a thing that joins two things together

examples.x: All cars have points for the attachment of safety restraints.
They discussed the attachment of new conditions to the peace plans.
They had to check the strength of the seat attachments to the floor of the plane.

senses.definition_vi: hành động nối một thứ với thứ khác; một thứ nối hai thứ lại với nhau

senses.definition: a feeling of love for somebody/something

examples.x: a child’s strong attachment to its parents
Prisoners can develop attachments to their guards.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác yêu thương ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: belief in and support for an idea or a set of values

examples.x: the popular attachment to democratic government

senses.definition_vi: niềm tin và sự ủng hộ đối với một ý tưởng hoặc một bộ giá trị

senses.definition: a tool that you can fix onto a machine, to make it do another job

examples.x: an electric drill with a range of different attachments

senses.definition_vi: một công cụ bạn có thể gắn vào máy để làm một công việc khác

senses.definition: a short time spent working with an organization such as a hospital, school or part of the armed forces

examples.x: a 4-month training attachment
She's on attachment to the local hospital.

senses.definition_vi: một thời gian ngắn làm việc với một tổ chức như bệnh viện, trường học hoặc một bộ phận của quân đội

senses.definition: an act of using violence to try to hurt or kill somebody

examples.x: Five people were killed in the attacks that took place last night.
the recent series of deadly terrorist attacks on European cities
a violent attack upon a police officer
vicious attacks against defenceless people
A child is recovering in hospital after a serious attack by a stray dog.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động sử dụng bạo lực để cố gắng làm hại hoặc giết ai đó

senses.definition: an act of trying to kill or injure the enemy in war, using weapons such as guns and bombs

examples.x: a bomb/rocket/missile attack
Rebel forces launched an attack on civilian targets.
Commanders attempted to prevent an attack against the city.
The patrol came under attack from all sides.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động cố gắng giết hoặc làm bị thương kẻ thù trong chiến tranh, sử dụng vũ khí như súng và bom

senses.definition: a sudden, short period of illness, usually severe

examples.x: to suffer an asthma attack
an attack of fever

senses.definition_vi: một giai đoạn đột ngột của bệnh tật, thường là nghiêm trọng

senses.definition: a sudden period of feeling an emotion such as fear

examples.x: a panic attack
an attack of nerves
He suffers from attacks of anxiety.
an attack of conscience (= a guilty feeling about something you have done or are planning to do)
an attack of the giggles

senses.definition_vi: một giai đoạn đột ngột của cảm xúc như sợ hãi

senses.definition: strong criticism of somebody/something in speech or in writing

examples.x: He found himself the victim of an unprovoked attack by the media.
She has laid herself wide open to attack.
It was seen as a personal attack on the president.

examples.cf: under attack (from somebody/something) (for something/for doing something)
examples.x: The school has come under attack for failing to encourage bright students.
Doctors have gone on the attack, accusing the government of incompetence.

senses.definition_vi: sự chỉ trích mạnh mẽ đối với ai đó/điều gì đó bằng lời nói hoặc bằng văn bản

senses.definition: the players in a team whose job is to try to score goals or points

examples.x: Germany's attack has been weakened by the loss of some key players through injury.

senses.definition_vi: những cầu thủ trong đội có nhiệm vụ cố gắng ghi bàn hoặc điểm

senses.definition: the actions that players take to try to score a goal or win the game

examples.x: a sustained attack on the Arsenal goal

senses.definition_vi: những hành động mà cầu thủ thực hiện để cố gắng ghi bàn hoặc giành chiến thắng trong trận đấu

senses.definition: an action that you take to try to stop or change something that you feel is bad

examples.x: to launch an all-out attack on poverty/unemployment

senses.definition_vi: một hành động bạn thực hiện để cố gắng ngăn chặn hoặc thay đổi một điều gì đó mà bạn cảm thấy là xấu

senses.definition: the action of something such as an insect, or a disease, that causes damage to something/somebody

examples.x: The roof timbers were affected by rot and insect attack.

senses.definition_vi: hành động của một thứ gì đó như côn trùng, hoặc bệnh tật, gây hại cho một thứ gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: to use violence to try to hurt or kill somebody

examples.x: Most dogs will not attack unless provoked.
Terrorists attacked several targets across the city.
A woman was brutally attacked by a gang of youths.
One of the men viciously attacked officers with a home-made weapon.
The man attacked him with a knife.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng bạo lực để cố gắng làm hại hoặc giết ai đó

senses.definition: to use weapons, such as guns and bombs against an enemy in a war, etc.

examples.x: Enemy forces attacked at night.
There are fears that the government is planning to attack neighbouring countries.
At dawn the army attacked the town.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng vũ khí, chẳng hạn như súng và bom chống lại kẻ thù trong chiến tranh, v.v.

senses.definition: to criticize somebody/something severely

examples.x: His latest work has been bitterly attacked by the critics.
He was publicly attacked for his political views.
The police have been attacked for failing to take immediate action.
She has been attacked for ignoring her own party members.
The council has been attacked over its lack of investment in public services.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ trích mạnh mẽ ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to have a harmful effect on something

examples.x: a disease that attacks the brain
The vines were attacked by mildew.

senses.definition_vi: có tác động có hại đến một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to go forward in a game in order to try to score goals or points

examples.x: Spain attacked more in the second half and deserved a goal.
A period of good attacking play gave Italy the lead.

senses.definition_vi: tiến lên trong một trận đấu để cố gắng ghi bàn hoặc điểm

senses.definition: to deal with something with a lot of energy

examples.x: Let's attack one problem at a time.

senses.definition_vi: xử lý một cái gì đó với nhiều năng lượng

senses.definition: to succeed in getting something, usually after a lot of effort

examples.x: Most of our students attained five ‘A’ grades in their exams.
We only consider applicants who have attained a high level of academic achievement.
attain (a) degree/standard/level/proficiency/mastery

senses.definition_vi: thành công trong việc đạt được một cái gì đó, thường là sau nhiều nỗ lực

senses.definition: to reach a particular age, level or condition

examples.x: The cheetah can attain speeds of up to 97 kph.

senses.definition_vi: đạt đến một độ tuổi, cấp độ hoặc tình trạng nhất định

senses.definition: an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult, often with no success

examples.x: I passed my driving test at the first attempt.
They made no attempt to escape.
The launch will go ahead despite the failure of previous attempts to create an online business.
Why have repeated attempts to find a permanent solution to the problem failed?
They were frustrated in their attempts to get an explanation.
He has failed in three previous attempts to win the world title.

examples.cf: in an attempt to do something
examples.x: Two factories were closed in an attempt to cut costs.
The couple made an unsuccessful attempt at a compromise.
They were praised for making an attempt at solving the problem.

senses.definition_vi: một hành động cố gắng làm một điều gì đó, đặc biệt là điều khó khăn, thường không thành công

senses.definition: an act of trying to kill somebody

examples.x: Someone has made an attempt on the president's life.
an assassination attempt
a murder/suicide attempt

senses.definition_vi: một hành động cố gắng giết ai đó

senses.definition: an effort to do better than something, such as a very good performance in sport

examples.x: his attempt on the world land speed record
a world-record attempt

senses.definition_vi: một nỗ lực để làm tốt hơn một cái gì đó, chẳng hạn như một màn trình diễn rất tốt trong thể thao

senses.definition: a thing that you produce as a result of trying to make or achieve something

examples.x: He was clearly pleased with his first attempt at a cake.

senses.definition_vi: một thứ bạn tạo ra như kết quả của việc cố gắng tạo ra hoặc đạt được điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make an effort or try to do something, especially something difficult

examples.x: I will attempt to answer all your questions.
She never attempted to explain her behaviour to her family.
She has been unsuccessfully attempting to find out the name of the police officer.
I haven't even attempted to do any of this yet.
